name: Bois des Iles Eau de Parfum
desc:
Bois des Iles Eau de Parfum "an invitation to travel," is a woody fragrance of oriental accents that aims to evoke the world of exotic and distant lands. We find precious sandalwood and ylang-ylang with mandarin and bergamot, placed on a base of tonka bean and vanilla.

The fragrances are available as a 75 ml and a 200 ml Eau de Parfum.

name: Bois Talisman
desc: Dior Bois Talisman is a new unisex fragrance set to be released in 2025, crafted by master perfumer Francis Kurkdjian. This gourmand, woody fragrance features key notes of vanilla, sweet sugar, and smoky cedarwood, offering a unique olfactory experience.

name: Tendre Poison Brume Parfumée
desc: Tendre Poison Brume Parfumée by Dior is a feminine fragrance with a green and citrusy profile. It features a blend of unique and captivating notes.
gender: women. Tendre Poison Brume Parfumée was launched during the 2020's. Top notes are Asafoetida, Bergamot, Brazilian Rosewood and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Rose, Tuberose, Orange Blossom, Freesia and Honey; base notes are Heliotrope, Sandalwood, Musk and Vanilla

name: Dior Homme Parfum 2025
desc:
Dior Homme Parfum 2025 is a new men's fragrance set to launch in 2025, crafted by Master Perfumer Francis Kurkdjian. This fragrance celebrates the iris flower, balancing power and delicacy with a blend centered around iris and highlighted by ambery woods. It is part of the Dior Homme fragrance collection, known for its seductive allure.

Francis Kurkdjian, Dior Perfume Director, reimagines Dior Homme through an architectural lens, blending structure and sensuality. With an overdose of noble iris, his new fragrance unites strength and tenderness, elegance and power.

name: Asad Bourbon
desc: Following the success of Asad and Asad Zanzibar, Lattafa introduces the third chapter in the Asad collection. This latest creation opens with a captivating blend of Pink Pepper, Lavender, and juicy Mirabelle Plum, setting the stage for its rich and indulgent heart. At its core, warm notes of Cacao, Davana, and Nutmeg create an opulent depth. The fragrance concludes with an alluring base of Vetiver, Bourbon Vanilla, and golden Amber, leaving an unforgettable trail of sophistication and allure.

name: Valentino Donna Born in Roma Extradose
desc: Valentino Born in Roma Donna Extradose is a new fragrance for women launched in 2025.

name: Dior Homme Intense 2025
desc:
Dior Homme Intense 2025 Eau de Parfum has been repackaged, maintaining its original formula. This fragrance exudes grandeur and sophistication, showcasing iris enriched with a captivating amber accent and a sumptuous woody base, leaving a sensual and enduring trail.

Like a sharply tailored Dior suit, Dior Homme Intense is the olfactive interpretation of modern masculinity. This masculine fragrance reveals the sophistication of a powerful eau de parfum, blending the olfactive intensity of powdery iris with a sensual ambery facet and a precious warm cedarwood base. Dior Homme Intense is a signature, sensual script whose trail calls to you.

The iconic Dior Homme bottle features a sleek, thoroughly modern design. The sculpted block of light, crystal-clear glass reflects the confidence of the modern man, while the translucent lacquer on the bottle echoes the intensified olfaction. The bottle is topped with a black cap bearing the DIOR HOMME logo, enshrined within a crystalline cube.

name: Harajuku Lovers Wicked Style Love
desc:
Gwen Stefani launches new Harajuku dolls in autumn 2010 named Wicked Style this time, dedicated to the wild fashion of Tokyo streets, especially Takeshita-Dori. Every girl has a "wicked style" on her own, expressed by cheerful colored hair, clothes and super cute shoes.

Harajuku Lovers Wicked Style Love is a floral - fruit fragrance made of nectarine notes, mango, pear, orange blossom, lotus , violet, osmanthus, blond wood, musk, sandalwood, praline and patchouli. Her style is inspired by the Rococo, with white sock, blouses, and petty coats.

Available as 10 and 30 ml EDT.

name: Eladaria
desc: Eladaria by Creed is a floral fragrance for women, set to be released in the spring of 2025. This enchanting scent reimagines the classic rose in a modern, radiant composition, blending light and shadow, sensuality and freshness. Inspired by a paradisiacal garden at dawn, Eladaria reflects the beauty of awakening nature with a vibrant play of floral calligraphy, powdery textures, and shimmering citrus accents.

name: Le Sunset
desc: In the enchanting artemoon glow. drinks by the courts overlooking the Mediterranean are almost a tradition at Le SunSet. As familiar faces gather, laughter and dinking glasses mingle with the blackcurrant and violet notes emanating from masterfuity prepared cocktails. inviting all to savour the moment. The war vetiver notes emerge while conversations get profound and the sun starts to set. Mesmerizing views are for everyone to enjoy. But Le SunSet is exclusive to the few who know how to."

name: By Your Side
desc: By Your Side by Tsu Lange is a fragrance that presents a grounded and smoky profile. The scent opens with a sharp edge of pink and black pepper, complemented by cardamom, and is softened by the presence of cedar. It evokes the feeling of being side by side with a lover, whether familiar or newly discovered.

name: J'Adore L'Or
desc:
Dior is presenting new J`Adore L`Or, created of rose absolute and jasmine from Grasse. The fragrance arrives on the market end of October as 40ml Essence de Parfum.

The new J’Adore L Or was created by Francois Demachy of high quality ingredients which were the key factor for quality of this fragrance. 'True luxury requires the highest level of ingredients quality and creation' – says Dior. His words were the basis for the new fragrance which will represent the house of Dior perfectly with its golden nuances.

Composition of the new edition includes highest quality materials which leave rich aromas on the skin and make it gentle, silky and soft. Nuance of this golden nectar is more intense and warm, just like real gold. As guarantee of quality, Dior accentuates ingredients used in perfume and which satisfy the highest criteria. The composition encompasses Centifolia rose absolute and Grandiflorum jasmine absolute from Grasse.

Extracts of flowers of J`Adore l`Or originate from "Domaine de Manon", managed by the same family for three generations. This family has been a supplier for Dior for years and they have maintained tradition of high quality till today.

Rose petals and jasmine were hand-picked and their scent leaves an impression of a delicate floral bouquet followed by oriental notes, which give precious charm to the fragrance. The base consists of soft and warm tonka bean absolute and sensual Tahitian vanilla absolute.

Oriental flavor originates from patchouli and drops of amber and labdanum, while leaving an impression of density - as formulated by perfumer Francois Demachy.

The bottle has the same shape as the classic amphora of the house of J `Adore, with the difference in the cap which is decorated with golden threads. Modeled on the Masai necklace (John Galliano's idea), stopper that exudes luxury was created. Face of an advertising campaign is Charlize Theron, the muse of modern gold variation of the perfume, wearing a John Galliano dress.

name: Les Creations de Monsieur Dior Diorama
Chance Eau Splendide
desc:
Chance Eau Splendide marks the inaugural fragrance under the leadership of Simona Cattaneo, president of Chanel Fragrance and Beauty. “I feel very honored and privileged to have joined such an iconic house that I have been looking at with a lot of respect for all of my career,” expressed Cattaneo, speaking in her first interview since joining Chanel in September 2024.

A luminous new CHANCE radiating with splendour. CHANCE EAU SPLENDIDE is a magnetic fragrance that unleashes an olfactory whirlwind, diffusing an elegant and captivating fruity-floral trail.

COMPOSITION

For CHANCE EAU SPLENDIDE, Olivier Polge, CHANEL In-House Perfumer-Creator, crafted a radiant and magnetic scent. A vibrant, sparkling raspberry accord, enriched with crisp fruity nuances, delicate rose, and violet facets, gracefully rises, unveiling an opulent and luminous floral heart centered around rose geranium. This exquisite geranium, cultivated exclusively in CHANEL's fields in Grasse, is naturally imbued with rosy freshness and subtle minty undertones. Complemented by sophisticated, powdery iris and enveloped by a mysterious cedar-white musk accord, the fragrance creates an alluring, fruity-floral whirlwind that is both elegant and mesmerizing.

Each fragrance in the Chance line is characterized by freshness and a distinctive olfactory signature. For Eau Splendide, perfumer Olivier Polge focused on an exploration of various fruity notes.
“I ended up being interested in one accord that smells like raspberry,” Polge explained. “I showcased it in an accord because aside from the red fruit and this peach aspect it naturally carries, it sets itself apart from other berries due to its inherent violet and rosy nuances. I thought: ‘Ah, that’s the start of the perfume.’”
The composition further highlights a pure extract of geranium rosat leaf, partially cultivated in Chanel’s own fields.
“It has this rosy, very natural impression,” noted Polge, who also infused musks and cedarwood into the fragrance’s base, creating a refined and lasting trail.

INSPIRATION

"Luck is my soul." Throughout her life, Gabrielle Chanel nurtured luck, believing passionately that anything was achievable and transforming dreams into reality. At CHANEL, luck is not chance—it is a state of mind, an intentional attitude. It signifies a powerful conviction to shape one's destiny. Sparkling, surprising, mystifying—Chance is never accidental; it emerges from timely encounters and intentional meetings, striking with exhilarating force. It captivates you, drawing you irresistibly into its whirlwind. Chance symbolizes audacious success, youthful spirit, and fate's playful invitation. Meant to be seized and treasured as a joy-scented talisman, it embodies continuous movement and renewal, perfectly reflected in its round, infinite bottle. It urges you to confidently bet on yourself, to choose your path, and embrace each new opportunity to play the game.

CHANEL EAU SPLENDIDE will be available as 50ml and 100ml Eau de Parfum, starting April 15th 2025.

name: Lion
desc: Lion by Rayhaan is a bold masculine fragrance combining fresh fruity accents with warm spices. The opening features a crisp pear note balanced by aromatic lavender and mint, transitioning to a heart dominated by cinnamon and cumin's earthy warmth. The base resolves into a creamy vanilla-amber accord supported by woody cedar and patchouli. While drawing inspiration from Jean Paul Gaultier's Ultra Male, it presents a distinctive spicy character with notable longevity and sillage.

name: Aldebaran
desc:
Like a luminous star in the night, this new fragrance is a soliflore of tuberose with milky facets and fresh petals, lightly enhanced with paprika and tonka beans. ALDEBARAN embodies hope and optimism.

ALDEBARAN takes its name from the brightest star discovered and observed by an 18th-century Arab astronomer. Its name, from the Arabic Al-Debaran, evokes the outstretched hand of one who helps and shows the way. This olfactory experience is a quest for optimism, like a journey through the looking glass, from darkness to light.
gender: women and men. This is a new fragrance. Aldebaran was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is Quentin Bisch. Top note is Tuberose; middle notes are Paprika and Mate; base note is Tonka Bean

name: Rose Star
desc: Rose Star by Dior is a floral fragrance developed by perfumer Francis Kurkdjian as part of La Collection Privée. The scent reinterprets the classic rose with a contemporary perspective, blending zesty and fruity top notes with the spiciness of Sichuan pepper. At its heart lies Centifolia rose, while honeyed and musky accords form the base, resulting in a composition that balances delicacy and intensity. The fragrance pays homage to Christian Dior's iconic symbols: the rose and the lucky star.

name: La Collection Couturier Parfumeur Cologne Royale
desc:
Dior launches a new exclusive collection of ten perfumes named La Collection Couturier Parfumeur in 2010., signed by the perfumer Francois Demachy. The collection illustrates the life of the founder - the famous Christian Dior.

The collection consists of re editions of three male fragrances: Eau Noire, Bois d'Argent and Ambre Nuit, and seven new ones: Mitzah, Vetiver, Granville, Leather Oud, New Look 1947, Cologne Royale and Milly-la-Foret. Vetiver and Leather Oud are masculine perfumes; Cologne Royale is suitable for both genders, while the rest are intended for the ladies.

Cologne Royale, inspired by traditional fragrant colognes, is a scent of citruses, neroli and white musk. Francois Demachy says that "Cologne is the ultimate challenge in perfumery, because it follows the strictest style codes. It is impossible to cheat. The olfactory signature must be clear and immediately recognizable. The quality of the fragrance is entirely dependent on the quality of the ingredients used, citrus ingredients in particular. So, of course, I sought out the most fragrant notes I could find."

The fragrances from Dior La Collection Couturier Parfumeur are available in bottles of 125 ml, 225 ml and 450 ml.
gender: women and men. La Collection Couturier Parfumeur Cologne Royale was launched in 2010. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy. The fragrance features Citruses, Neroli and Musk
