name: Le Sel D'Issey Eau de Parfum
desc: Le Sel D'Issey Eau de Parfum by Issey Miyake is a fragrance for men introduced in 2025. This scent is characterized by a marine and woody composition, blending mineral salt and seaweed notes to evoke the freshness of the sea. Incense forms the heart, while amber and cedarwood in the base provide a warm and solid woody trail.

name: Marwa
desc: Arabiyat Prestige Marwa is a sophisticated fragrance inspired by Louis Vuitton's Imagination, blending citrus, spicy, and woody elements. It opens with vibrant citrus notes, transitions to an exotic heart with ginger and cinnamon, and settles into a warm base of guaiac wood and ambroxan. Designed for evening wear or special occasions, it offers a bold, long-lasting scent with a modern twist on classic aromas.

name: Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet Hair Mist
desc:
Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet Hair Mist Fragrance Mist by Dior, was released in 2025. A delicate addition to the Miss Dior collection, this mist offers a graceful and refreshing olfactory experience tailored for hair.

The scent opens with a sweet pea and sparkling burst of bergamot, setting a fresh and luminous tone. At the heart, a delicate bouquet of peony and Damask rose unfolds, exuding grace and romantic charm. Anchoring the composition, a whisper of white musk lingers at the base, leaving a light, clean trail that envelops the hair in a veil of sophistication.

name: Miss Dior Eau de Parfum Hair Mist
Frozen Flame
desc: Frozen Flame by Hawthorne is a fragrance that contrasts warmth and coolness, blending sweet black vanilla, sharp chrome, and smooth white cedar. The scent is described as cozy and decadent, yet maintains a clean, metallic edge, offering a balance between timelessness and modernity.
gender: women and men. This is a new fragrance. Frozen Flame was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is Linda Song. The fragrance features Vanilla, Metallic notes and Cedar

name: Les Récoltes Majeures Le Muguet
desc: “Orchestrated around absolutes of Grasse Centifolia rose and jasmine, this lily-of-the-valley reflects how I have perceived the flower, how Christian Dior himself undoubtedly experienced its scent as it bloomed in May at La Colle Noire.” - Francis Kurkdjian, Perfume Creative Director, Parfums Dior
gender: women. This is a new fragrance. Les Récoltes Majeures Le Muguet was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance features Grasse Rose, Lily of the Valley and Jasmine

name: Angel Dust
desc: Angel Dust Extrait de Parfum by Fugazzi is a unisex fragrance designed to evoke quiet confidence through intimate, skin-close aromatics. Centered around Cashmeran - a modern synthetic molecule known for its soft woody-musky character - the scent creates a cocoon of warmth with enhanced depth from white amber crystals and peppery accents. The Extrait version intensifies the original EDP's formula with higher oil concentration, resulting in longer-lasting sillage that maintains subtlety rather than projection.

name: Bois d’Argent Esprit de Parfum
desc:
Bois d’Argent Esprit de Parfum by Dior is a highly concentrated fragrance from the La Collection Privée line, created by Francis Kurkdjian. This rendition of the iconic Bois d’Argent highlights the radiant and velvety quality of Tuscan iris, contrasted with ambroxan and ambergris accents. The composition is further enriched by frankincense and honey, creating a mysterious and intense trail.

“With this Esprit de Parfum, I wanted to flesh out the addictive ‘skin-to-skin’ facet of Bois d’Argent. Dominated by the intensely rich iris absolute and the accord’s signature frankincense note, the Bois d’Argent Esprit de Parfum plays with contrasts. It 'classically' exalts the nobility and radiant elegance of the flower, all while darkening it with a new voluptuousness and sensuality. Its trail finds itself exhilarating, radical and powerfully sustained by an extreme concentration to obtain a Bois d’Argent enhanced with mystery...” Francis Kurkdjian, Perfume Creative Director, Parfums Dior.

Available in 80ml Extrait de Parfum.
gender: women and men. This is a new fragrance. Bois d’Argent Esprit de Parfum was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance features Honey, Frankincense, Tuscan Iris, Ambergris, Vanilla and Ambroxan

name: Goddess Parfum
desc: Goddess Parfum by Burberry, introduced in 2025, is a fragrance for women that belongs to the oriental and gourmand families. The composition opens with notes of lavender and raspberry, followed by a heart of vanilla, and settles into a base featuring a suede leather accord.

name: Powdery Tobacco
desc: This fragrance combines tobacco leaves with sweet honey and vanilla accords, accentuated by ginger and gourmand elements of dry fruits and cacao. Its composition aims to evoke the atmosphere of a London club lounge through warm, resinous base notes.

name: Pacific Aura
desc: Rayhaan Pacific Aura is a citrus aquatic fragrance designed for men, positioned within the brand's Pacific line. It opens with a citrus blend of citron, mandarin, mint, and bergamot, accented by black currant and coriander. The heart introduces aromatic and floral elements through basil, rose, and carrot seed, while the base settles into warmth with amber, fig, and ambroxan. The composition aims to evoke ocean breezes and sunlit coastal environments through its fresh, aquatic character.

name: Overdose Killer Oud
desc: Overdose is an intense oriental-spicy fragrance designed for men, characterized by its bold combination of alcoholic, resinous, and woody elements. The fragrance opens with an intoxicating cognac accord blended with spices including cumin, cardamom, nutmeg, saffron, and ginger, complemented by grapefruit. The heart features resinous notes of myrrh, labdanum, and benzoin alongside cinnamon, mastic, patchouli, and geranium. The base evolves into animalic and smoky notes with sandalwood, incense, leather, and sage.

name: ODETTE
desc: Odette by Amelio is a fragrance that evokes memories of family gatherings, childhood holidays, and comforting rituals. The scent blends soft notes of vanilla, almond, warm milk, and icing sugar, creating an olfactory experience reminiscent of pastries and nostalgic escapes. Rooted in the ambiance of the Latin Quarter, Odette combines elements of Sicilian and Spanish influences with a sense of warmth and familiarity.
gender: women and men. This is a new fragrance. ODETTE was launched in 2025. The fragrance features Sandalwood, White Musk, Vanilla, Almond, Sugar and Milk

name: Miss Dior Essence
desc:
Miss Dior Essence by Dior is a concentrated fragrance created by Francis Kurkdjian, released in 2025. This composition features a jammy blackberry and elderflower accord in the opening, leading to a lush jasmine sambac heart. The base is anchored by dense, enveloping oak wood notes, resulting in a floral-chypre scent with gourmand and woody nuances. The perfume is designed for women and reflects a confident, liberated femininity.

"Like the girls of today, my Miss Dior, with its intensity, its concentration and the pervading, addictive trail it leaves, is hyper-feminine, all while rejecting anything that might limit her freedom.
In its "Essence" version, it is the olfactory reflection of confident femininity, a sensual, colorful nectar that melts onto the skin, intensely dedicated to the extravagant younger generation that refuses gloominess."
- Francis Kurkdjian, Perfume Creative Director, Parfums Dior.

name: Gabrielle Fragrance Primer
desc:
The first step in the GABRIELLE CHANEL Art of Perfuming, this lightweight mist preps the skin with instant freshness and hydration, enhancing the radiance and longevity of your fragrance.

Benefits

Immediately boosts skin hydration, softness, and suppleness

Enhances comfort and freshness

Leaves a light, luminous floral veil

Composition
Infused with the signature blend of four white flowers—jasmine, ylang-ylang, orange blossom, and Grasse tuberose—for a radiant, airy scent.

Inspiration
Named after the woman before the fragrance—Gabrielle "Coco" Chanel—who redefined freedom and femininity.

How to Use
Mist generously onto pulse points before applying fragrance, or wear alone for a delicate, refreshing scent. Housed in a sleek glass bottle that reflects the iconic GABRIELLE CHANEL aesthetic.

name: Verano
desc:
Montabaco Verano joins our Four Corners of the Earth collection capturing the essence of Latin America and now called simply "Verano."

Verano is a seductive and profound scent of leather, wood and tobacco leaf with a good measure of grapefruit for added bravado and a dash of cashmeran for a sensual creamy dry-down. Presented in a stunning azure bottle giving it centre stage as we pay homage to our inspirational world.

name: Bleu de Chanel L'Exclusif
desc: Bleu de Chanel L'Exclusif is an ambery-aromatic fragrance for men, created by Olivier Polge and set for release in 2025. This composition is characterized by its dense and sophisticated structure, with an emphasis on woody notes, particularly New Caledonian sandalwood. The fragrance features resinous cistus labdanum, amber, leather, and other woody notes, resulting in a scent that is both intense and balanced. Designed to build in slow, deliberate layers, it offers a warm, enveloping trail with a magnetic and lingering presence.
gender: men. This is a new fragrance. Bleu de Chanel L'Exclusif was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Polge. The fragrance features Amber, Woody Notes, Labdanum and Sandalwood

name: Island Dreams
desc:
Island Dreams is a fragrance that whisks you away to a world where turquoise waters meet endless skies. It opens with the sparkling brightness of bergamot and the spicy warmth of ginger, instantly awakening your senses like a refreshing island breeze. The vibrant grapefruit accord at its heart adds a juicy, sun-kissed energy that feels both invigorating and uplifting.

As the scent settles, the elegant depth of ambroxan intertwines with the smooth sensuality of musk, creating a warm and addictive embrace that lingers like the memory of a perfect getaway. Each spray is a reminder of white sandy beaches, gentle waves, and the carefree spirit of island life. Khadlaj Island Dreams isn’t just a fragrance — it’s a ticket to your own private paradise, bottled for you to carry anywhere.

name: Aqua Fahrenheit
desc:
Dior presents new fiery refreshment from February 2011. Aqua Fahrenheit is the new fragrance, an explosive combination of fire and water elements.

Aqua Fahrenheit, a masculine scent that offers a new kind of refreshment, is dedicated to adventurers and freelancers whose spirit knows no bounds. The start of the composition symbolizes the element of water that gradually takes on the characteristics of fire.

It opens with lively Italian citruses – fresh tangerine and grapefruit. Intense floral notes of violet in the heart are updated with aromatic basil and mint. The signature base of burning woods features notes of vetiver from Haiti and leather. The composition is signed by perfumer Francois Demachy.

The perfume bottle retains the distinctive elongated shape and clean lines of the original, highlighted by an intense and fiery color of red and orange. It also allows two types of fragrance application – you can choose the “splash” form of classical colognes or the "spray" form of perfumes.

Dior Aqua Fahrenheit is available in bottles of 75 and 125 ml.

name: J'Adore Extrait de Parfum
desc:
In Spring 2014 Dior presented the collection of Dior Les Extraits, which includes five cult fragrances for women by Dior and in perfumery in general. The collection encompasses mini editions available as perfume extract: Miss Dior, Miss Dior Original, Diorissimo, Poison and J’adore, which are, as announced by Dior, "much more than fragrances, because they possess philosophy of perfumers: the spirit of Dior radiant through the tiniest details, pervading perfumes in all phases of production, from their creation to meticulous selection of raw ingredients, art of bottling to delicacy of packaging."

Perfume J'Adore is based on May rose absolute enveloped in rich layers of ylang-ylang from the Comori islands and intense jasmine absolute dominating the composition.
gender: women. J'Adore Extrait de Parfum was launched in 2014. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy. The fragrance features Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine Sambac and May Rose

name: Miss Dior Cherie Extrait de Parfum
desc: Miss Dior Cherie Extrait de Parfum is a more concentrated and more intensive version of Dior Miss Dior Cherie fragrance from 2005. This floral fruity chypre composition reveals the seductive and elegant side of the fragrance with notes of mandarin, jasmine and patchouli. It is available as perfume extract in bottles of 7.5 ml.

name: Miss Dior Parfum
desc: Miss Dior Extrait de Parfum is a more concentrated and more intensive version of the first Dior fragrance Miss Dior from 1947. This elegant and refined green chypre composition includes notes of galbanum, jasmine and patchouli. It is available as perfume extract in bottles of 7.5 ml.

name: Midnight Poison Extrait de Parfum
desc: Midnight Poison Extrait de Parfum is a more concentrated and more intensive version of the Dior fragrance Midnight Poison from 2007. This sensual and extreme version of the already intense composition features rare rose absolute, tonka, vanilla and labdanum. Each bottle is unique, decorated with spiral lines that are reminiscent of a couture gown. It is available as perfume extract in bottles of 7.5 ml.

name: Hypnotic Poison Extrait de Parfum
desc: Hypnotic Poison Extrait de Parfum is a more concentrated and more intensive version of the Dior Hypnotic Poison fragrance from 1998. Francois Demanchy reinterprets the original composition by Annick Menardo with notes of vanilla, May rose, Sambac jasmine and orange blossom. It is available as perfume extract in bottles of 7.5 ml.
gender: women. Hypnotic Poison Extrait de Parfum was launched during the 2000's. Hypnotic Poison Extrait de Parfum was created by Annick Menardo and François Demachy. Top notes are Jasmine and African Orange Flower; middle note is Rose; base note is Vanille

name: Crème de Menthe Café
desc: A decadent scent designed for those who savor indulgence. Crème de Menthe Café is a cozy, gourmand escape—where the richness of dark roasted coffee meets the silky melt of after-dinner chocolate mints. At the heart, a swirl of cool peppermint flirts with velvety cacao, gradually warming into a luscious blend of steamed espresso and creamy vanilla. A final splash of Irish crème liqueur lingers on the skin, adding a smooth, boozy finish that’s both comforting and undeniably seductive. This unisex fragrance wraps you in the luxurious familiarity of café culture and after-hours indulgence. Wear it when the night is still young, or when you want to carry a little dessert with you throughout the day.

name: Coco Mademoiselle Fragrance Primer
desc: A luminous body mist infused with the unmistakable COCO MADEMOISELLE signature, designed to prepare the skin for fragrance. Its fresh, airy texture delivers a veil of hydration and freshness in one effortless spritz. Encased in the iconic glass bottle, the primer radiates notes of vibrant orange, delicate rose and jasmine, and the timeless elegance of patchouli. Worn alone, it imparts subtle radiance; paired with any COCO MADEMOISELLE fragrance, it enhances and intensifies the trail.

name: Sauvage Eau de Toilette Into The Wild
desc:
For the very first time, the 30 ml Sauvage bottle is dressed in a limited-edition case inspired by one of Dior’s most iconic designs. More than just a fragrance, this bottle becomes a travel companion, an object conceived to follow you on every journey.

Sauvage Eau de Toilette For The Wild was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy. Top notes are Calabrian bergamot and Pepper; middle notes are Sichuan Pepper, Pink Pepper, Patchouli, Lavender, Geranium, Vetiver and elemi; base notes are Labdanum, Ambroxan and Cedar.

The perfume case is not available for purchase separately. Each 30 ml Sauvage bottle can be refilled with its corresponding fragrance refill.

name: Sauvage Eau de Parfum Into The Wild
desc:
For the very first time, the 30 ml Sauvage bottle is dressed in a limited-edition case inspired by one of Dior’s most iconic designs. More than just a fragrance, this bottle becomes a travel companion, an object conceived to follow you on every journey.

Sauvage Eau de Parfum For The Wild was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy. Top note is Bergamot; middle notes are Lavender, Sichuan Pepper, Star Anise and Nutmeg; base notes are Ambroxan and Vanilla.

The perfume case is not available for purchase separately. Each 30 ml Sauvage bottle can be refilled with its corresponding fragrance refill.

name: Sauvage Parfum Into The Wild
desc:
For the very first time, the 30 ml Sauvage bottle is dressed in a limited-edition case inspired by one of Dior’s most iconic designs. More than just a fragrance, this bottle becomes a travel companion, an object conceived to follow you on every journey.

Sauvage Parfum For The Wild was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy. Top notes are Bergamot, Mandarin and elemi; middle note is Sandalwood; base notes are Frankincense, Tonka and Vanilla.

The perfume case is not available for purchase separately. Each 30 ml Sauvage bottle can be refilled with its corresponding fragrance refill.

name: Miss Dior Cherie Eau de Parfum
desc:
New version of Miss Dior Cherie EDP is arriving on the market soon and will be announced with a new advertising campaign featuring charming Natalie Portman.

This is a new version which is more subtle and charming that the edition from 2005. The new edition is being created by Francois Demachy who combines essences to contribute to more sophisticated presentation of Dior's Cherie. Dior's girl is grown up and is now a woman who loves!

name: Meant To Be Seen
desc:
A scent that anchors the light when you feel unseen.

There are moments when the world looks through you—when your presence is softened, your voice hushed, your radiance dimmed by self-doubt or silence.
Meant to Be Seen is born from those moments. Not to mask them, but to transform them.

It is a fragrance that acts as an anchor of light—a quiet yet powerful reminder that your essence deserves to be felt, noticed, remembered.

Opening with the delicate brightness of bergamot and the tender grace of violet, the scent begins with a breath of clarity. At its heart, the rich creaminess of iris butter intertwines with moxalone and a soft animalic trace of civettone, creating a sensation of vulnerability refined into strength—delicate, yet unwavering.

The base grounds this luminescence with unexpected warmth. Sesame and sandalwood brings a nutty, textured depth, while ambrettolide and akigalawood wrap the composition in a radiant, skin-like finish—soft, sensual, and lingering.

Meant to Be Seen is not just a perfume—it is a declaration. For the quiet ones. For the daydreamers. For those whose glow has been dimmed but never lost. This is the scent that finds you in your stillness and reminds you:

You were never meant to hide. You were always meant to be seen.
gender: women and men. This is a new fragrance

name: Chanel No 5 Eau de Cologne
desc: The legendary Chanel No 5, which was created by Ernest Beaux in 1921 for Coco Chanel, was originally launched in three concentrations: Parfum, Eau de Toilette and Eau de Cologne. Eau de Cologne was discounted in 1990s and replaced by Eau de Parfum. Each concentration is slightly different.
gender: women. The nose behind this fragrance is Ernest Beaux. Top notes are Aldehydes, Ylang-Ylang, African Orange Flower, Bergamot and Amalfi Lemon; middle notes are Iris, Jasmine, Rose, Orris Root and Lily-of-the-Valley; base notes are Civetta, Musk, Amber, Sandalwood, oak moss, Vetiver, Patchouli and Vanille

name: Ombre Tonka
desc:
For Ombre Tonka, it all started with a playful gesture. His daughter suggested pistachio, light-hearted, unusual, almost mischievous. A note Pierre Montale, master perfumer, could not resist exploring. From this game was born a revelation. Pierre, the silent architect of Mancera, shaped the idea into a fragrance of contrasts, where sweetness hides in shadow, where tonka’s addictive warmth meets the strength of noble woods, where the unexpected becomes inevitable.
Ombre Tonka is the story of opposites and affinities. The crunch of pistachio against the velvet of Venezuelan tonka, the brightness of bergamot against the depth of amber woods, the caress of vanilla against the resinous embrace of benzoin. A creation both cosmopolitan and timeless, familiar yet mysterious.

Top Notes:
Turkish Pistachio, Juicy Bergamot from Calabria, Hint of Thai Oud Wood
A surprising opening where crunchy pistachio and sparkling citrus meet the delicate mystery of oud, creating brightness with a playful twist.

Heart Notes:
Venezuelan Tonka Bean, Intense Amberwood, Rose de Mai
At the core lies the addictive velvet of tonka, wrapped in the strength of amber woods and lifted by the elegance of rose.

Base Notes:
Vanilla Pods from Madagascar, Malaysian Patchouli, Benzoin from Sumatra
A rich and magnetic base, where resinous warmth blends with creamy vanilla and earthy patchouli for a long-lasting, enveloping trail.

Ombre Tonka is a daring gourmand creation that unites sweetness with strength. Its playful pistachio note, born from a moment of spontaneity, unfolds into a dialogue of light and shadow, softness and depth. The fragrance is unisex, modern, and powerful — the pure essence of Mancera. It captures the spirit of September, the perfect companion for autumn travelers.

The Riviera, turned up.


Available as 60ml and 120ml Eau de Parfum.

name: J'adior Solid Perfume J'adore L'Or
desc:
"The J’adior solid perfume is highly concentrated and infused with jasmine wax. It melts into skin on contact, to delicately perfume it and prolong its trail. Its innovative clear formula features radiant gold glitter that enhances skin with a subtle iridescent finish. The J’adior solid perfume is applied on pulse points – neck, décolleté and wrists – alone or as a complement to touch up the spray version.

A bold new signature version of the cult-classic slogan “J’ADORE DIOR” is being unveiled as: J’ADIOR. The couture case features the slogan in golden metal letters, making it the ultimate accessory to take with you everywhere you go.

Notes of orange blossom absolute, jasmine grandiflorum and centifolia rose create the powerful, sensual signature of L’Or de J’adore.

This translucent, alcohol-free fragrance stick is infused with jasmine wax and dotted with flecks of gold, enhancing the skin with a subtle iridescent finish.

Apply the fragrance stick on pulse points: wrists, neck and décolleté. The J’ADIOR fragrance stick can be used alone or in addition to the J’adore Eau de Parfum to amplify its trail."
gender: women. This is a new fragrance. J'adior Solid Perfume J'adore L'Or was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance features Jasmine, Rose and Orange Blossom

name: Higher Black
desc:
Dior launches Higher Black perfume to commemorate the first anniversary of the original Higher in 2002. Higher Black is a limited bottle containing the perfume composition of the original. The perfume was created by Olivier and Olivier Pescheux Gillotin as aromatic - woody.

Top notes: lemon, peach, pear and mint. Heart: rosemary, spices and cypress. Base: musk and pear tree.

Available as EDT.

name: Miss Dior Essence by Maison Février
desc:
"To celebrate this new exceptional edition of 50 numbered bottles, Miss Dior is adorned with feathers for the first time, thanks to the virtuoso savoir-faire of the artisans at the famed Parisian fine feather atelier, Maison Février. Expert collaboration at its best to create a rare bottle, imagined in the spirit of the most beautiful ballgowns.

Black like the bottle’s iconic bow, white for jasmine and stars, pink to evoke the composition of Miss Dior Essence. Adding an exquisite, ethereal touch of color, the feathers in the exceptional bow created by Maison Février are pure enchantment. Hand-crafted from goose, ostrich and rooster feathers, this final flourish is the product of extreme precision and ancestral savoir-faire. The bottle’s infinitely elegant label has been delicately crafted using a technique known as feather marquetry.

The spectacular bow pairs beautifully with the composition of Miss Dior Essence by Francis Kurkdjian, a colorful and sensual nectar. The jammy blackberry and elderflower accord transcends a bouquet of jasmine that remains true to the original 1947 composition and gains complexity with a woody base note of dark, enveloping oak."

Available in bottles of 200ml.

name: Sauvage Rare Blend
desc: Sauvage Rare Blend is a very limited edition reinterpretation of Dior’s 2015 men’s fragrance. Developed by perfumer Francis Kurkdjian, it centers on three dedicated infusions—oud, vanilla, and labdanum—assembled using traditional techniques to emphasize depth and density. The fragrance is presented in a dark crystal bottle crafted by Baccarat and was produced in an edition of 15 bottles, each 350 ml.
gender: men. This is a new fragrance. Sauvage Rare Blend was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance features Vanilla, Oud and Labdanum

name: Le Nectar de J'Adore
desc:
Le Nectar de J'Adore is a limited edition Extrait that revisits the J'adore signature with a focus on its floral heart. The composition features centifolia rose and jasmine grandiflorum absolutes, enriched with a Grasse tuberose pomade obtained by enfleurage. This edition is presented in a sculptural bottle created in collaboration with artist Marc Quinn.

"In this exclusive version of J'adore, the magnificent floral heart has been enhanced with absolutes of centifolia rose and jasmine grandiflorum. Enriched with a Grasse tuberose pomade—created using an ancestral enfleurage technique—the fragrance celebrates the radiant, round and sensual notes of this captivating flower."

Christian Dior Le Nectar de J'Adore is available in 200 ml Extrait.
gender: women. This is a new fragrance. Le Nectar de J'Adore was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance features Tuberose, Jasmine and Rose

name: Forbidden Temptation
desc:
Forbidden Temptation by Vivamor is a rich, warm fragrance built around a blend of fruit, booze, spices, and woods. The composition opens with a pairing of plum and French cognac, giving the scent a dark, fruity and liqueur-like impression. At its heart, Brazilian tonka bean, cinnamon, and tobacco add sweetness, spice, and a smoky nuance, while the base of Haitian vetiver, amber, and Madagascan vanilla provides an earthy, resinous and creamy foundation.

"The Vivamor Parfums team is thrilled to announce the launch of Forbidden Temptation, Extrait de Parfum, our latest collaboration with fragrance expert, Darian from the Bowtie Fragrance Guy."
gender: women and men. This is a new fragrance

name: Cuir Saddle
desc: Cuir Saddle by Dior is a 2025 unisex fragrance in the La Collection Privée line, created by Francis Kurkdjian as a contemporary interpretation of leather. The composition is built around a leather accord that is treated in a softened, suede-like manner rather than as a dense, tarry leather, reflecting a more tactile and supple idea of the material. The Dior Saddle bag serves as a stylistic reference point, linking the fragrance to one of the house’s recognizable fashion designs. The scent combines smoky nuances and suede with musky and floral tones, layered over modern amberwood. This structure aims to maintain a clear leather character while reducing heaviness and sharpness, resulting in a smoother, more moderated leather profile with a refined, gently warm finish.
gender: women and men. This is a new fragrance. Cuir Saddle was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance features Musk, Leather, Suede, Floral Notes and Amberwood

name: Cristalle Eau de Toilette
desc:
Eau de toilette Cristalle was created in 1974, by the famous Chanel perfume creator Henri Robert. A perfect and pure fragrance composition reminds of an ideally lined crystal. Clear green notes reveal a wide spectrum: from green spicy basil to sweet petitgrain, a perfect beginning followed by exuberant eruption of lemon and bergamot freshness. The green note of galbanum unites the citrus notes and extends their glorious melody. The heart is composed of hyacinth and jasmine, but their luxuriance is subordinate to the perfect lines of the entire composition. The base includes oak moss and wood.

The perfume belongs to the floral-chypre olfactive group. Eau de parfum Cristalle was created by Jacques Polge in 1993. While EDT is mysterious and astringent \'chypre\', eau de parfum is sweeter and richer. The verdure of the top notes is significantly moderated, and bergamot is replaced by sweet mandarin. Juicy peach and melon repel the dark notes characteristic for EDT, and bring out the whole composition to the daylight. Exotic luxury of ylang-ylang and jasmine contrasts the soily nuance of vetiver and oak moss.

name: Addict To Life
desc:
The new edition of the original Dior Addict perfume from 2002., Addict To Life, launches in June 2011. Addict To Life is described as shimmering, vibrant, indefinable, unique and unforgettable fragrance that focuses on sparkling and intense rose.

“She swings with life. She moves to the sounds of the city. Her heartbeat is in sync with the frenetic tempo of world metropolises. Her stilettos click out a wild rhythm. She captures the slightest oscillation. She is tuned in to the latest fashions. She is the new trend and represents the future of fashion. She lives her life in Technicolor. She is a slave to nothing and free from everything. She scoffs at codes. Why set down rules for anything? She knows what she wants. No one can make her stray from her own desires. She wants to live intensely, completely. She draws her strength, her carefree nature and her joie de vivre from the very source of life. From the source of her fragrance. A 100% addictive elegant floral. She finds her energy, truth and force within it. This woman is you, us, me. We are all Addicted to Life. We are all Addicted to Dior.”(Dior)

The in-house perfumer, Francois Demachy, created this fragrance with noble floral notes, trying to evoke the light and joy of life. The composition begins with pomegranate, raspberry and peach. The heart tones of rose, jasmine and lily of the valley are followed by the base of cedar and white musk.

It is available as 50 and 100 ml Eau de Toilette. The face of the campaign is model Karlie Kloss.

name: Addict Purple Glow Eau De Parfum
desc:
Combining the colourful vibrancy of fruit with the refined beauty of flowers, Purple Glow reimagines the Dior iris. A delicious sensorial experience—a fragrance that makes you glow with delight.

Purple Glow showcases the beauty of Tuscan iris with crystallised petals and candied raspberry nuances, as if dusted in floral confectionery sugar. Magnetic and intense, Purple Glow unfurls in a captivating and charming trail.

name: Addict Peachy Glow Eau de Parfum
desc:
Peachy Glow intertwines facets of juicy peach and velvety jasmine absolute, melting into a cloud of vanilla whipped cream. A delicious floral infusion that captures the flower's glistening spirit.

Joyful and velvety, the gourmand trail of Peachy Glow creates an enveloping olfactive harmony -- a comforting delight with vibrant colors.

name: Addict Rosy Glow Eau de Parfum
desc: Under its soft pink shade, Rosy Glow is infused with Damascena rose essence with bright lychee accents, all wrapped in a creamy accord with caramelized notes. Sparkling and delectable, Rosy Glow is a true olfactory confection that sparks instant wonder and immediately has you craving more.

name: Le Beau Narcisse
desc: In a radiant Eden of gold and precious stones, Jean Paul Gaultier unveils Le Beau Narcisse Eau de Parfum. Irresistible and magnetic, he commands every gaze with an amber-musk scent—like a forbidden caress that announces his presence before he appears. Upon the skin, sparkling bergamot breathes a wave of freshness, musk slowly unveils a deep sensuality, and tonka bean ignites an intense, addictive allure.

name: Cosmic Kylie Jenner Intense
desc:
Cosmic Kylie Jenner Intense by Kylie Cosmetics is a women's fragrance released in January 2026. According to the brand, it builds on the original Cosmic perfume, featuring a warmer, creamier profile.

The scent highlights a blend of citrus, floral, and ambery tones supported by soft musk and vanilla. The composition opens with bright blood orange and heady star jasmine, leading into a heart of amber and benzoin, adding a resinous, balsamic warmth. In the base, vanilla and musk create a smooth, comforting finish that emphasizes the fragrance’s sweet-ambery character.

name: Coach Cherry
desc:
Coach Cherry by Coach is described as a fruity floral fragrance for women, inspired by the lively atmosphere of New York City and the idea of inner confidence. The composition focuses on a vivid cherry accord, supported by the floral nuance of jasmine sambac and the deeper, earthy tones of patchouli.

Available in Parfum concentration.

name: Chanel No 19 Eau de Parfum
desc:
Number 19 in the name refers to the birth date of Coco Chanel, August 19. The perfume was launched in 1970 when Coco Chanel was 87 years old, a year before she died. It was created by Henri Robert, a perfume creator which created many other perfumes of the Chanel house.

Number 19 Eau de Parfum is a floral-woody-green fragrance, a white and green floral harmony. It is a unique blend of light-heartedness and sophistication, not simply a different concentration, but an olfactory reinterpretation, which is faithful to the spirit and base notes of the original composition. Top notes: green notes and bergamot. Heart: rose and iris. Base: vetiver, oakmoss and leather.

Available as 35, 50 and 100 ml EDP.
gender: women. Top notes are Green Notes, Bergamot and Neroli; middle notes are Iris, Rose, Narcissus, Lily-of-the-Valley and Ylang-Ylang; base notes are oak moss, Vetiver, Leather and Sandalwood

name: Chanel No 19 Parfum
desc:
Number 19 in the name refers to the birth date of Coco Chanel, August 19. The perfume was launched in 1970 when Coco Chanel was 87 years old, a year before she died. It was created by Henri Robert, a perfume creator which created many other perfumes of the Chanel house.

This is a floral –woody - green fragrance of white flowers and green nuances. It is available as 7.5 ml pure perfume.

name: Someday
desc:
Aiming at girls from 14 to 18 years old, who make up most of his fans, the teen pop star Justin Bieber launches his first prestige market fragrance named Someday. Perfumer Honorine Blanc of Fiermenich created the fragrance as a delicious fruity – gourmand, appropriate for the age of its expected audience. Lance McGregor designed the ultra girly bottle with its stopper shaped as a flower of layered hearts and removable charms hanging from its neck. The print campaign is photographer by Terry Richardson, featuring Dree Hemingway.

Top notes: juicy mandarin, pear, wild berries. Heart: fresh jasmine and creamy flowers. Base: vanilla and soft musk.

Justin Bieber Someday is available as Eau de Parfum in bottles of 30, 50 and 100 ml, with products such as scented hair mist and body lotion.

Note: Perfume review pages are designed for essays or posts that give a critical evaluation of a fragrance you have smelled, know and have formed an opinion of, based on your own experience. Abuse of the ratings or reviews features may get you banned from access to the website.

name: Stallion Leather Sirocco
desc: Stallion Leather Sirocco by Carolina Herrera is a leather-based fragrance that continues the Stallion Leather series, drawing inspiration from Carolina Herrera’s connection with her racehorse Balaclava. Named after the warm desert wind, it is presented as a limited edition that reflects themes of movement, instinct and open-air rides at sunset. The composition is described as a leather woody gourmand, combining salty and smoked leather facets with warm spices, resinous sweetness and modern woody notes.

name: Eau Sauvage Fraicheur Cuir
desc: This limited edition of the classic Eau Savage kept all the original notes, as well as the bottle. Fraicheur Cuir means “the freshness of the leather”; the fragrance justifies its name: mild and warm leather note and amber make a contrast to the freshness of the opening. Top notes are composed of Sicilian lemon; hedion is at the heart, together with aromatic herbs and cedar. The base kept its chypre structure, with a leather accord, which is not strong animalistic one, yet it is mild and warm. This classic fragrance by Edmond Roudnitska was refined by François Demachy in the limited edition Eau Sauvage Fraicheur Cuir 2007.

name: Chanel No 19 Poudre
desc: Iris is the central ingredient of the fragrance, along with several "new interesting musks", found by the perfumer. Talking about iris, the perfumer pointed out it is a very demanding ingredient. First of all, it's hard to source, because anything can affect the final quality of the oil, including climate and soil. Secondly, processing of iris is very time and labor-consuming process, which lasts a couple of years. However, Chanel never made a single compromise about the quality of her (their) perfumes. The new No.19 Poudré (2011) unites the latest technology advances (musks) and the best that can be achieved in a good old artisanal way.

name: Les Exclusifs de Chanel Jersey
desc: Les Exclusifs de Chanel Jersey by Chanel is a new fragrance for women to be launched in 2011. The fragrance is named after the favorite textile of Coco Chanel - Jersey. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge.
gender: women. Les Exclusifs de Chanel Jersey was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge. The fragrance features Lavender, Musk, Vanille, Tonka Bean, Wildflowers, Grass, Rose and Jasmine

name: Miss Dioramour
desc:
Miss Dioramour by Dior is a 2026 special edition within the Miss Dior line, created by Francis Kurkdjian. It contains the Miss Dior Parfum (2024) fragrance and is presented in a limited series of 150 numbered bottles of 200 ml.

The flacon is adorned with a hand-crafted silk bow featuring a poetic print originally designed by Marc Bohan, reflecting Dior’s couture heritage.

Olfactively, Miss Dioramour is described as a bright, intense chypre composition with a citrus opening of tangerine and mandarin leading into a jasmine heart, set against a backdrop of amber and woody notes. The result is a floral chypre profile with a warm, ambery-woody character.

name: Jules (2026)
desc: Jules by Dior is a men's fragrance recreated by Francis Kurkdjian and scheduled for release on October 1, 2026. It is one of thirteen Dior classics revisited by Kurkdjian, returning to the character of Jean Martel's 1980 composition. The fragrance retains an animalic, leather-led profile with fresh and woody facets. Its amber and woody foundation features patchouli, cedar, vetiver and sandalwood, while the 2026 version includes adjustments to the spices, moss, tonka bean and lavender, the latter represented through both absolute and essence.
gender: men. This is a new fragrance. Jules (2026) was launched in 2026. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance features Moss, Leather, Cedar, Lavender, Woody Notes, Vetiver, Spicy Notes, Animal notes, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Amber and Tonka Bean

name: Forever and Ever (2026)
desc:
Forever and Ever by Dior is a fragrance reinterpreted by Francis Kurkdjian, released on October 1, 2026.

Created in 2002 by Jean-Pierre Béthouart, Forever and Ever is a fresh, delicate floral fragrance. A bouquet of newly blossomed flowers, radiant and spontaneous, composed with freesia and rose notes.

name: Allure Homme Eau Fraîchissante pour l'Été
desc:
Chanel launches new Allure fragrances in 2002, created as lighter versions of the original editions Allure for men and women. The fragrance was created by Jacques Polge, and it is a woody oriental one. The bottle is designed by Jacques Helleu.

Top notes: aldehydes, bergamot, mandarin and orange. Heart: cedar and vetiver. Base: pink pepper, tonka and labdanum.

name: Allure Eau Fraîchissante pour l'Été
desc:
Chanel launches new Allure fragrances in 2002, created as lighter versions of the original editions Allure for men and women. The fragrance was created by Jacques Polge, and it is a feminine fresh aldehyde, floral and oriental one.

Top notes: aldehydes, bergamot, grapefruit, mandarin and blood orange. Heart: jasmine, May rose, magnolia, water lily and honeysuckle. Base: vetiver and vanilla.

name: Forever and Ever Dior
desc: Dior released Forever and Ever again, in a new, limited edition Forever and Ever Dior and in a new packaging. The fragrance is the same, with aquatic jasmine, freesia and ivy in the top notes; almond flower, pelargonium and rose are in the heart. The base is made of vanilla, musk and nutmeg.

name: Dior Addict 2 Logomania
desc: Dior Addict 2 Logomania is a limited edition of the original Dior Addict 2, which was released in 2006. The base notes are: bergamot, grapefruit, orange, pink fruit, floral notes, sandalwood and white musk.
gender: women. Dior Addict 2 Logomania was launched in 2006. The fragrance features Sandalwood, Floral Notes, White Musk, Orange, Grapefruit, Bergamot and Red Berries

name: Coco Voile Parfumé
gender: women. Coco Voile Parfumé was launched during the 1980's. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge. Top notes are Mandarin Orange, Frangipani, Coriander and Pimento; middle notes are Orange Blossom, Ylang Ylang, Cinnamon, Angelica, Jasmine, Rose and Iris; base notes are Musk, Frankincense, Tonka Bean, Patchouli, Benzoin, Amber, Civet and Honey

name: Chanel N°19 Voile Parfumé
gender: women. Top notes are Bergamot, Galbanum, Hyacinth and Neroli; middle notes are Lily of the Valley, Ylang Ylang, Narcissus, Jasmine, Rose and Iris; base notes are Sandalwood, Oakmoss, Leather, Cedar and Musk

name: J'adore Intense
desc:
J'adore Intense by Dior is a floral fragrance that emphasizes a dense, nectar-like character. Centered on jasmine, rose, and ylang-ylang, the composition presents these flowers in a rich and saturated way, with a nuanced, honeyed and slightly fruity impression. A base of soft sandalwood and vanilla adds warmth, roundness, and a gentle gourmand facet to the bouquet.

Created by perfumer Francis Kurkdjian and released in 2026, J'adore Intense continues the J'adore line with a focus on heightened floral intensity.

“For this intense new concentration, I wanted to create a honeyed floral nectar: colorful, delectable and marked by a luscious roundness, as if all the flowers were revealing an irresistible intensity, bursting with color. ”

name: Chanel No 5 Eau de Toilette
desc: N°5 Eau de Toilette by Chanel is a floral aldehydic fragrance, presented as a lighter and woodier interpretation of the original N°5 Parfum. Created as a new expression of the N°5 idea in 1924, it is described as a "woody abstract floral" that maintains the floral-aldehydic character of the classic while introducing a more pronounced woody facet. The scent is built around a bouquet of rose, jasmine and ylang-ylang, enhanced by aldehydes for lift and radiance, with sandalwood and vetiver providing depth and a drier, woody undertone. The fragrance is marketed as a women’s scent and is presented in a streamlined bottle inspired by the 1924 design.

name: Chanel No 5 Eau de Toilette - Vintage
desc: N°5 Eau de Toilette by CHANEL is a floral aldehydic fragrance with a subtly woody character, presented as a more transparent and textured interpretation of the original N°5. Created as a new expression of the N°5 idea introduced in 1921 by Gabrielle Chanel and perfumer Ernest Beaux, the Eau de Toilette version appeared in 1924 with a slightly woodier profile. It is offered in a minimalist bottle inspired by the 1924 design, emphasizing a streamlined presentation of this well-known accord. 1924 is the year when Chanel Parfums was established.

name: Rhubarb Thief
desc: Rhubarb Thief by Heretic is a green, tart composition built around the contrast of sharp fruits, aromatic herbs, and woody-mossy undertones. Bright grapefruit peel, cedar, angelica, thyme, verbena, and carrot seed open the fragrance with a vivid, slightly bitter and herbal freshness. The heart centers on rhubarb, supported by pink jasmine and cypress for a nuanced floral-green character. In the base, elemi resin and oakmoss add a lightly resinous, earthy depth that grounds the livelier top and heart notes.

name: Miss Dior Cherie Blooming Bouquet 2011
desc:
Miss Dior Cherie Blooming Bouquet is described as a modern, elegant and exuberant floral fragrance that embodies effortless femininity and all that the color pink supposed to represent. This summer version begins with an explosion of citrus fruits and Sicilian oranges. Its heart is governed by peony flower enriched with rose absolute. Warm and creamy character of the fragrance is provided by the base composed of patchouli and white musk.

Miss Dior Cherie Blooming Bouquet is available as 50 ml Eau de Toilette.

name: Gaith
desc: Gaith by Khadlaj is a spicy and aromatic fragrance that opens with pepper, pink peppercorns, and ginger. Its heart blends incense, lavender, and cypress, while patchouli, labdanum, and vanilla form a warm, resinous base with soft sweetness.
gender: women and men. Gaith was launched during the 2020's. Top notes are Pepper and Ginger; middle notes are Incense, Lavender and Cypress; base notes are Patchouli, Vanilla and Labdanum

name: Lily Jasmine
desc: Lily Jasmine by Fresh is a fragrance introduced in 2023. It opens with bergamot, lavender, and pink pepper, followed by a floral heart of clary sage, lily of the valley, and jasmine sambac. The base combines cedarwood, moss, and amber, giving the composition a softly woody finish.

name: Coeur Fetish Amber
desc:
Coeur - Fetish Amber is a Le Vestiaire des Parfums fragrance by Yves Saint Laurent, created by Daniela Andrier and released in 2026.

Inspired by the heart-shaped talisman associated with Yves Saint Laurent and worn by the house's muses, the composition centers on a contrast between bright aldehydes and a warm amber accord. Cardamom, lavender, orris and floral notes are supported by amber, almond, cedarwood, patchouli, myrrh, cistus and musk, giving the scent a spicy floral-amber character.

name: Dior Paradise
desc: Dior Paradise is a 2026 fragrance by Dior for La Collection Privée, created by Francis Kurkdjian. Inspired by the almond orchard at Château de La Colle Noire in Provence, it centers on bitter almond, accompanied by mandarin, orange, and lime, with tonka bean adding warmth and a softly gourmand character.

name: La Collection Couturier Parfumeur Patchouli Imperial
desc:
Potent and sensual patchouli is of core essence to the house of Dior since the beginning of the New Look revolution from 1947.

Full of elegance, composition Patchouli Imperial created by perfumer Francois Demachy is a celebration of this legendary oriental ingredient with sophisticated ingredients of this newly created composition. Patchouli is the central note – ingredient with among herbal notes offers the stronger animalistic effect. This is refined reveal, unprecedented elegance.
gender: men. La Collection Couturier Parfumeur Patchouli Imperial was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy. The fragrance features Indonesian Patchouli Leaf, Sandalwood, Coriander, Cedar, Calabrian bergamot and Sicilian Mandarin

name: Miss Dior Parfum Roller-Pearl
desc:
In 2026, Miss Dior Roller-Pearl presents the Parfum version from 2024 in a compact 20 ml travel format with a glass-bead applicator.

The fragrance is described as floral, fruity, and woody, built around bright mandarin, jasmine with fruity and rosy facets, and ambery tones; the bottle also references the line's houndstooth motif and couture label.

name: Miss Dior Eau de Parfum Roller-Pearl
desc: Miss Dior Roller-Pearl by Dior is a travel-friendly rollerball presentation of Miss Dior Eau de Parfum, designed for direct application to pulse points. The fragrance is described as a floral chypre composition built around Centifolia rose, with almond-like vanilla nuances and a soft, milky sandalwood accord.

name: Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet Roller-Pearl
desc: Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet Roller-Pearl is a travel-friendly Eau de Toilette format of the floral chypre fragrance from Dior. The composition centers on fresh bergamot, Damascena rose, and peony, with musk and white cedarwood adding a soft, clean, and lightly woody finish. The roller-pearl presentation is designed for easy application on pulse points.

name: 1957 Extrait de Parfum
desc:
1957 by Chanel is an Extrait de Parfum presented as part of the Les Extraits de Chanel collection. The fragrance is described by the brand as a concentrated interpretation that highlights refined raw materials and traditional perfumery craftsmanship, offered in a faceted bottle with a thread cutter accessory.

1957 – an emblem of Gabrielle Chanel's success. An extrait de parfum where neroli and iris pallida unite with a cedar-musk accord, enriched with vetiver and sandalwood.
gender: women and men. This is a new fragrance. 1957 Extrait de Parfum was launched in 2026. The fragrance features Iris, Vetiver, Cedar, Musk, Sandalwood and Neroli

name: Cuir de Russie Extrait de Parfum
desc: Cuir de Russie by Chanel is an extrait de parfum from the Les Extraits de Chanel collection. The fragrance centers on a leather accord shaped by birch wood and labdanum, with jasmine and May rose adding a floral dimension, while soft tobacco nuances lend warmth and depth.
gender: women and men. This is a new fragrance. Cuir de Russie Extrait de Parfum was launched in 2026. The fragrance features Birch, Jasmine, Tobacco, May Rose and Labdanum

name: Sycomore Extrait de Parfum
desc: Sycomore Extrait de Parfum by Chanel is part of the Les Extraits de Chanel collection. This version of the fragrance centers on vetiver, accompanied by vanilla, spices, and cedar, creating a warm woody composition with spicy facets. The perfume is presented as being inspired by Gabrielle Chanel's childhood memories.
gender: women and men. This is a new fragrance. Sycomore Extrait de Parfum was launched in 2026. The fragrance features Vetiver, Spices, Cedar and Vanilla

name: 1932 Extrait de Parfum
desc: 1932 by Chanel is an extrait de parfum from the Les Extraits de Chanel collection. Inspired by the house's first High Jewellery collection of 1932, the fragrance centers on jasmine and iris-like orris facets with a pear-grapefruit accent, ylang-ylang, and vetiver, developing into a floral aldehydic composition with powdery, musky, woody, and softly resinous nuances.

name: Beige Extrait de Parfum
desc: Beige by Chanel is an extrait de parfum from the Les Extraits de Chanel collection. The fragrance centers on neroli and jasmine, combined with a floral accord of hawthorn, freesia, and frangipani, with honeyed nuances that add warmth and softness to the composition.
gender: women and men. This is a new fragrance. Beige Extrait de Parfum was launched in 2026. The fragrance features Frangipani, Jasmine, Freesia, Honey, Hawthorn and Neroli

name: N°22 Extrait de Parfum
desc: N°22 by Chanel is a floral aldehydic extrait de parfum originally created in 1922 and presented here as part of the Les Extraits de Chanel collection. The composition is described as a powdery floral built around aldehydes, tuberose, rose, and orange blossom nuances, with ylang-ylang, jasmine, and nutmeg in the heart, resting on a soft base of vanilla, vetiver, and iris.

name: Coromandel Extrait de Parfum
desc: Coromandel by Chanel is an extrait de parfum from the Les Extraits de CHANEL collection, inspired by Gabrielle Chanel's Coromandel screens. The fragrance centers on patchouli, opening with bitter orange, neroli, and crisp citrus, and developing into a warm base of benzoin, frankincense, amber, incense, white chocolate, and woods, with soft leathery nuances suggested by labdanum in the brand's description.

name: Bois des Iles Extrait de Parfum
desc: Bois des Iles by Chanel is part of the Les Extraits de Chanel collection. In this extrait de parfum version, the fragrance centers on sandalwood, tonka bean, ylang-ylang, and ambrette seed, resulting in a warm, softly floral, and woody composition. Chanel associates the scent with the atmosphere of a Parisian cabaret.
gender: women and men. This is a new fragrance. Bois des Iles Extrait de Parfum was launched in 2026. The fragrance features Ylang-Ylang, Sandalwood, Ambrette and Tonka Bean

name: Jersey Extrait de Parfum
desc: Jersey Extrait de Parfum by Chanel is part of the Les Extraits de Chanel collection. It is presented as a richer interpretation of Jersey, centered on soft lavender and rose, with white musk and vanilla adding a smooth, warm, and powdery dimension.
gender: women and men. This is a new fragrance. Jersey Extrait de Parfum was launched in 2026. The fragrance features White Musk, Lavender, Rose and Vanilla

name: Chanel N°5 Eau Premiere
desc:
For Chanel No°5 fans, Chanel is launching a new version of the world-renowned perfume – Chanel N°5 Eau Premiere. This modern and seductive fragrance was adapted from the original Chanel N°5 by Jacques Polge.

The new version of the \'old\' fragrance is lighter, fresher, softer, more delicate, and suitable for every-day use. Chanel N°5 Eau Premiere includes all original ingredients of N°5: rose absolute, jasmine, neroli and ylang-ylang. Ylang-ylang for this fragrance comes from the Comoro Islands, and Jasmine from Chanel-owned fields in Grasse. The face on the ad is again Nicole Kidman.

Chanel No°5 Eau Premiere comes in 150ml bottle (US$125) and will be available at department stores and other Chanel retailers in October 2007.

name: Double Scoop
desc: Double Scoop by Abel is a fragrance centered on a contrast between aromatic rosemary and toasted black sesame, followed by a butterscotch heart and a base of vanilla and musk. The composition suggests a gourmand-leaning profile with herbal, nutty, and soft musky facets.

name: Boss Bottled Beyond for Her
desc: Boss Bottled Beyond for Her is a 2026 fragrance by Hugo Boss created by Quentin Bisch, Benoist Lapouza, and Louise Turner. It introduces a women’s edition within the Boss Bottled Beyond line and is built around a contrast between luminous peony and rich maple syrup, with amber woods adding warmth and depth. The composition is presented as a floral-amber scent that balances radiant floral facets with sweet, woody accents.
gender: women. This is a new fragrance. Boss Bottled Beyond for Her was launched in 2026. Boss Bottled Beyond for Her was created by Benoist Lapouza, Quentin Bisch and Louise Turner. Top note is Peony; middle note is Maple syrup; base note is Amberwood

name: Les Creations de Monsieur Dior Diorling
desc:
In early 2012 Dior is announcing a reedition of the popular fragrance from 1963 named Diorling. This fragrance was characterized by its chypre-leather composition and its perfumer was Paul Vacher. The original fragrance was introduced in the early sixties as the scent of ''English refinement''.

The new version Diorling joins the collection Les Creations de Monsieur Dior, and perfumer of the edition is Francois Demachy. In spirit of the old edition, Diorling will offer you Calabrian bergamot, Egyptian jasmine, patchouli and leather.

Diorling 2012

top: Calabrian bergamot
heart: Egyptian jasmine
base: patchouli, leather

In any case, this composition is made more contemporary with an intention to achieve balance between the original fragrance and modern fragrance.

Flacon of the new version has the same form as the above mentioned collection, which offers eight classic fragrances by Dior. Diorling will hit the shelves after January 30th 2012, in 100ml flacons.

name: Gold Standard
desc: Gold Standard by Influxious is a 2026 fragrance built around a bright fruity-citrus opening and a warm amber-gourmand base. It opens with blood orange, Calabrian bergamot, Nigerian ginger, and mango, moves into saffron, Moroccan neroli, and ambrette, and settles into caramel, vanilla, tonka, musk, rum, and amber.

name: Coco Mademoiselle Crush Absolu
desc:
Coco Mademoiselle Crush Absolu is a 2026 fragrance from Chanel, created by Olivier Polge as a new interpretation within the Coco Mademoiselle line.

It combines a bright grapefruit and lychee accord with rose and jasmine, over a base of patchouli, vetiver, vanilla, and an amber-woody, lightly powdery character.

name: Miss Dior Couture Edition
desc:
Miss Dior Couture Edition is a limited modern interpretation of a classic for 2011. This edition is inspired by the original Miss Dior fragrance, which was launched by Christian Dior as an expression of his “new look” in 1947. Miss Dior Couture Edition represents a touch of elegance, grace and high fashion, as well as joie de vivre of today's young women.

This modern chypre - floral composition is signed by the in –house perfumer Francois Demachy. Rich and fresh citrus aromas from the opening include notes of bergamot, orange and mandarin, and gradually develop into a floral harmony of jasmine and rose absolute. The final accords of patchouli, sandalwood and vetiver give the chypre character to the fragrance.

The bottle design is reminiscent of Miss Dior Cherie EDP edition, with a special luxury detail that is a hand sewn, hand tied, pale pink satin bow at its neck. The face of the fragrance is actress Natalie Portman.

name: Bois D'Argent
gender: women and men. Bois D'Argent was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy. The fragrance features Myrrh, Iris, Musk and Floral Notes

name: Eau Noire
desc: Eau Noire is one of the three perfumes from unisex collection, introduced in 2004. All three bottles (Bois D`argent, Eau Noire and Cologne Blanche), were designed by Hedi Slimane, who was in charged for Dior’s prestige Pour Homme pret-a-porter collection. Francis Kurkdjian is the creator of this fragrance. Grassy – spiced sage note and pleasant and fresh anis open the composition. The heart follows with lavender, Virginian cedar and coffee, and the base is warm and powdery soft with leather, vanilla and violet. It is created as cologne available in 125, 250 and 500 ml bottles.

name: Cologne Blanche
desc: Cologne Blanche is one of the three perfumes from unisex collection, introduced in 2004. All three bottles (Bois D`argent, Eau Noire and Cologne Blanche), were designed by Hedi Slimane, who was in charged for Dior’s prestige Pour Homme pret-a-porter collection. They are available as 125, 250 and 500 ml eau de cologne. This fragrance opens with grassy – mint woody

name: J'Adore Shimmering Hair Mist
desc: J'adore Shimmering Hair Mist by Dior is a floral hair mist released in 2026. Created by Francis Kurkdjian, it adapts the J'adore signature for the hair with notes of ylang-ylang, Damask rose, jasmine grandiflorum, and jasmine sambac, and is presented as leaving a light shimmering finish.
gender: women. This is a new fragrance. J'Adore Shimmering Hair Mist was launched in 2026. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance features Jasmine Sambac, Damask Rose, Ylang Ylang and Jasmine

name: Dune Sun
desc: Dune Sun is an alcohol free summer fragrance, presented in 2003 as floral – fruity composition available in a 100 ml EDT bottle. Dior Dune Sun stands in the horizon between blue sky and yellow sand, waiting to be touched and felt. Sweet breeze comes with the top notes of refreshing black currant, dry and intensive yuzu, and fresh – sweet mandarin, all perfectly blended in with lotus, freesia and jasmine. The base is tenderly soothed with powdery vanilla, sandalwood and sensuous musk. Dune Sun carries the same form as the female Dune perfume, blurry glass bottle in a yellow – blue box.

name: I Love Dior
desc: This light limited edition was introduced in 2002 along with the declaration of love, I love Dior. The story begins with sourly-spiced refreshing notes of bitter orange, together with fresh and sweet notes of tangerine, sweet and intense freesia and magnolia. In the heart there are delicate floral notes of lily-of-the-valley with thin grassy green nuance of rose, slightly softened with nutmeg, green nuances of pear, honey-woodsy notes of night flower, honeysuckle and a touch of sweet and passionate raspberry. The base is sensual and made of cedar, musk and amber. The bottle is nicely dressed in jeans, carrying the message I Love Dior.

name: Dior Addict Dior Twist
desc: Dior Twist is a limited version of the first Addict Dior perfume. It was launched in 2004, in a very interesting bottle, packed in seductive, black corset inspired by the collection Couture Dior. The perfume composition starts with accords of mandarin orange leaves. Dominant fruity, smoky accords of Bulgarian rose, sensual orange blossom and exotic cactus blossom come after the fresh, green, hot notes. Soft, warm and powdery notes of bourbon vanilla, sandalwood and tonka bean are in the base.
gender: women. Dior Addict Dior Twist was launched in 2004. middle notes are Bulgarian Rose, Night blooming Cereus and Orange Blossom; base notes are Sandalwood, Tonka Bean and Bourbon Vanilla

name: Eternity for Men Suede Essence
desc:
Eternity for Men Suede Essence by Calvin Klein is a concentrated men's fragrance centred on a leather-fougère suede accord.

The fragrance opens with an invigorating burst of bergamot, delivering sparkling citrus brightness, while clary sage introduces aromatic, herbaceous nuances with a subtle green, slightly earthy character. The combination feels clean, sophisticated, and effortlessly fresh.

At its core, classic fougère materials take centre stage. Lavender lends aromatic elegance and soothing freshness, while geranium adds a crisp, minty-rosy facet that sharpens the composition and gives it a refined, masculine structure. Together, they create a polished floral-aromatic heart that is timeless yet contemporary.

The drydown is smooth, sensual, and enveloping. Velvety suede introduces a supple leather softness without smokiness, while bourbon vanilla brings creamy warmth and subtle sweetness. Tonka bean enriches the base with almond-like, lightly spiced facets that blend seamlessly with the vanilla, creating a refined ambered trail that feels elegant rather than gourmand.
gender: men. This is a new fragrance

name: Spicebomb
desc:
Viktor & Rolf present the male equivalent of the famous Flowerbomb fragrance (2005) and the second men's fragrance after Antidote (2006) under the name of Spicebomb. The designer duo wanted to give men the fragrance that is Flowerbomb to women, bearing in mind that spices are for masculine scents what flower notes are for feminine.

Spicebomb comes out in January 2012 as an explosive and extrovert oriental - woody and spicy composition. Perfumer Olivier Polge blended spices with sensual undertones; creating two diametrically opposed fragrant accords: 1. the addictive and fiery one and 2. the explosive and icy one. The fiery accord contains notes of chili, saffron, leather, tobacco and vetiver. The explosive one includes bergamot, grapefruit, elemi and pink pepper.

Fabien Baron designed the bottle so it looks like a hand grenade, which “triggers” with the designer’s logo. The face of the campaign is a model Sean O'Pry, photographed by Inez van Lamsweerde and Vinoodh Matadin.

The fragrance is available as 50 and 90 ml Eau de Toilette with 200 ml shower gel and 100 ml after shave balm.

name: Eau de Dior Coloressence Energizing
desc: Eau de Dior Coloressence Energizing is a true energy cocktail, very pleasant and refreshing. It was introduced in 2000 together with Dior Coloressence Relaxing. They are both female fragrances and they both share the same bottle design, only the stoppers are in different colors. This one is known for the green stopper and box. It was created by Max Gavarry in an aromatic composition. Top notes caress with a fresh and light breeze of shiny lemon, orange, mint and sweet – lemony notes of verbena. The heart develops with narcotic rose, wrapped up in sweet and powdery violet and magnolia. The base is sensual, dominated by white musk, along with oakmoss that adds dark earthy note to the composition. Besides Energinzing and Relaxing, 100 ml body lotions can also be found in versions of Dazzling Flowers (colored in blue), Passion Wood (orange) and Sweet Musk (violet bottle and box).

name: Eau de Dior Coloressence Relaxing
desc: Eau de Dior Relaxing is a true refreshing cocktail, very intensive, but completely pleasant. It was introduced in 2000 together with Eau de Dior Energizing. They are both feminine fragrances and they both have the same bottle design, only different colored stoppers. This one is known for the pink stopper and box. It was created by Domitille Michalon in an aromatic composition. Top notes include fresh scents of lemon tree and fig juice (milk). The heart is composed of narcotic rose, soft powdery violet and balmy note provided by Tonka, along with cedar and milky – powdery sandalwood that create an oriental tone. This perfume is characterized as the long lasting. Besides Energinzing and Relaxing, 100 ml body lotions can also be found in versions of Dazzling Flowers (colored in blue), Passion Wood (orange) and Sweet Musk (violet bottle and box).

name: Sauvage Extrait
desc: Sauvage by Dior is an Extrait released in 2026 as part of the Sauvage collection. Created by Francis Kurkdjian, it opens with bergamot, French lavender, and ambroxan, followed by a heart centered on Vietnamese oud. Indonesian patchouli, Madagascan vetiver, Virginia cedar, and Atlas cedar form the base, giving the fragrance an aromatic woody character with fresh, smoky, and dry nuances.

name: Virtus
desc: Virtus by RiiFFS is a fragrance built around a fresh-spicy opening of ginger, bergamot zest, and cardamom, followed by a floral heart of lily of the valley, orange blossom absolute, and neroli. The base combines Clearwood, ambroxan, and musk, giving the composition a clean woody-musky finish with a modern character.
gender: women and men. This is a new fragrance

name: Miss Dior Eau de Parfum (2026)
desc:
Miss Dior Eau de Parfum (2026) by Dior is a reformulated edition of the house's fragrance for women, now created by Francis Kurkdjian. It continues the Miss Dior line with a composition built around Centifolia rose absolute from Grasse, supported by rosewood and patchouli, and a warm base of sandalwood, vanilla, and tonka bean.

The scent is presented as a creamy floral with honeyed rose facets and a soft, woody-vanillic drydown.

The 2026 edition also introduces a revised bottle featuring Dior's signature houndstooth motif on the bow.

"The first fragrance by the House of Dior is reinvented in the most couture of bottles, presented by Natalie Portman in a new chapter imbued with love and flowers. A creation inspired by the ultimate declaration. An ode to love, the eternal signature of the House of Dior."

Miss Dior 2026 is available in 30 ml, 50 ml, 100 ml, and 150 ml Eau de Parfum.
gender: women. This is a new fragrance. Miss Dior Eau de Parfum (2026) was launched in 2026. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance features Rose de Mai, Rose, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Patchouli, Sandalwood and Palisander Rosewood

name: Jasmin des Anges Esprit de Parfum
desc:
Jasmin des Anges Esprit de Parfum by Dior is a 2026 unisex fragrance created by Francis Kurkdjian. This more concentrated interpretation of Jasmin des Anges is inspired by the end of a summer day in Grasse, when jasmine grandiflorum becomes especially rich and full in the lingering heat. The composition centers on jasmine with syrupy, apricot-like nuances, accompanied by strawberry and peach for a warm, fruit-tinged floral effect.

"La Collection Privée Christian Dior has now created highly concentrated Extraits de Parfum: the Dior Esprits de Parfum. With a bold, modern touch, Francis Kurkdjian, Perfume Creative Director, reinterprets the silhouettes of the iconic fragrances, revealing intense and radical facets. Fragrance trails that, through their extreme concentration, push the boundaries of what is possible and embody all excess.

Dior Jasmin des Anges Esprit de Parfum, with its high concentration of Jasmin Grandiflorum, evokes a stroll through a jasmine field at dusk. These blossoms, bathed in the warmth of the sun, exude intoxicating, liqueur-like notes with deliciously fruity nuances. This creates a play of contrasts between the radiant sunlight and the density of this liqueur-like heart note.

A precious nectar, captured in a bottle with clean, modern lines that radiates understated elegance. The signature silhouette is enhanced by a black couture label."
gender: women and men. This is a new fragrance. Jasmin des Anges Esprit de Parfum was launched in 2026. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance features Peach, Jasmine and Strawberry

name: Divine Intervention
desc: Divine Intervention by Liberation of Flowers is an Eau de Parfum with a floral-fruity opening of rose damascena and apricot. The heart introduces tobacco, cinnamon, cardamom, Casablanca lily, and a nutty accord, while the base settles into milk, caramel, vanilla orchid, and ambrette musk for a creamy, softly spiced finish.

name: Sillage de Marrakech
desc: Sillage de Marrakech is the debut fragrance from Maison Rihla, created with perfumer Chris Maurice and released in 2026. Inspired by impressions of Marrakech at dusk, the composition combines a fruity-spicy opening of pomegranate, raspberry, and pink pepper with a floral heart of neroli, ylang-ylang, and rose. Ambergris is placed in the heart of the fragrance, giving warmth to the center of the composition before a sweet, resinous base of vanilla, benzoin, and tonka bean develops.
gender: women and men. This is a new fragrance

name: Althaïr Exclusif
desc: Althaïr Exclusif composes an olfactory sonata around intense Bourbon vanilla, enhanced by the velvety nuances of amaretto and the warm glow of saffron. Addictive, refined, and captivating.
gender: men. This is a new fragrance. Althaïr Exclusif was launched in 2026. Althaïr Exclusif was created by Hamid Merati-Kashani and dsm-firmenich. Top notes are Amaretto, Saffron and Bergamot; middle notes are Praline, Cinnamon, Orange Blossom and Cardamom; base notes are Bourbon Vanilla, Ambrox Super and Guaiac Wood

name: Decision 42 Man
desc: The new fragrance that was launched in 2026. Decision 42 features Aromatic, and Woody notes with top notes of Pink Pepper, Bergamot, Neroli, and Cinnamon, followed by middle notes of Cardamom, Frankincense, Juniper, Myrrh, Pine TAR, and Sandalwood, and base notes of Cedarwood, Labdanum, Patchouli, and Vanilla.

name: Miss Dior Eau Fraiche
desc:
A Dior fragrance line, which use to stand by the name of Miss Dior Cherie, is renamed simply "Miss Dior" as a tribute to the original Miss Dior fragrance from 1947. In spring of 2012, the collection expands with the latest edition - Miss Dior Eau Fraiche. Miss Dior Eau Fraiche, described as elegant and bold as it is feminine and sensual, is a fresh green chypre - floral fragrance.

Deep and sensual, while being coquettish and invigorating scent of sunny spring, Miss Dior Eau Fraiche opens with sparkling citrus notes and green galbanum. The heart of the perfume is traditionally composed around jasmine, lying on the intensive base of earthy patchouli. The composition is signed by the in-house perfumer Francois Demachy.

The fragrance is available as 50 and 100 ml Eau de Toilette.

name: Diorama (2026)
desc:
Diorama by Dior is a reinterpretation of the house's 1949 fragrance, created by Francis Kurkdjian as part of a series of 13 reinvented Dior classics. The composition emphasizes jasmine while seeking to restore the character and radiance of the original.

Created in 1949 by Edmond Roudnitska, Diorama is the second fragrance of the House. An avant-garde scent that laid the foundations for abstract expressionism in the world of perfumery. Crafted with the same precision as a haute couture gown, it balances contrasting accords of spices and flowers. An olfactory incarnation of the great elegance and sophistication that Christian Dior so cherished.

name: Eau Fraîche (2026)
desc:
Eau Fraîche (2026) by Dior is a unisex chypre fragrance from the Dioriginals collection, reformulated by Francis Kurkdjian and announced for release on October 1, 2026. The composition emphasizes bergamot, lemon, mandarin orange and orange, alongside its characteristic basil and tarragon accord, while removing later modifications to the formula.

Created in 1955 by Edmond Roudnitska, Eau Fraîche, a pioneer of fresh fragrances, was Christian Dior's own perfume. Its trail offers a sensation as invigorating as diving into cool water on a hot summer's day. A crystalline freshness with lemon notes enhanced by a basil and tarragon accord, elevated by the depth of vetiver.

name: Diorella (2026)
desc:
Diorella by Dior is a 2026 reinterpretation of the fragrance first created in 1972. Part of a project revisiting 13 Dior classics, Francis Kurkdjian’s version reinstates a fruity apricot note and uses modern ingredients to evoke the character of the earlier composition.

Created in 1972 by Edmond Roudnitska, Diorella is the feminine counterpart to Eau Sauvage. A fragrance of freedom, independence, and youth, it reflects Christian Dior's joyful spirit. Its trail evokes the melody of jasmine and violet, enhanced by oakmoss and wrapped with fruity notes.

name: Higher (2026)
desc:
Higher by Dior is a 2026 reinterpretation of the house's 2001 fragrance of the same name. Created by Francis Kurkdjian, it is part of a series of thirteen reinvented Dior classics and is released on October 1, 2026.

Created in 2001 by Olivier Gillotin and Olivier Pescheux, Higher expresses a refined, urban masculinity. Vibrant and subtle, its trail blends spicy and fruity notes with woody notes of cedar and musk.

name: Paris – Saint-Moritz
desc:
Paris-Saint-Moritz by Chanel is an eau de toilette in the Les Eaux de Chanel collection.

An ambery-musky fragrance that captures the essence of St. Moritz. A luminous and enveloping winter-inspired scent that invites you to embark on a journey and soak in the beauty of a winter's day.

The PARIS–ST. MORITZ fragrance is composed of a fresh and fruity pear accord, which is accentuated by the refined elegance of a floral rose facet. Sensual musky-ambery notes add an element of contrast. A warm, enveloping composition with the same spontaneous quality that is intrinsic to the LES EAUX DE CHANEL collection, leaving a distinctly recognisable scent on the skin.

Beginning in the late 1920s, Gabrielle Chanel indulged in Alpine pleasures and the joys of winter sports in St. Moritz. High atop the pristine snow-capped mountains, she delighted in donning elegant warm outfits, never having to choose between comfort and style.

PARIS–ST. MORITZ captures the full essence of this destination in a cosy, enveloping scent that wears like winter clothing.

The bottle features a sleek design and rounded shape that fits perfectly in the palm of your hand, lending itself to lavish and generous perfuming. With a single spray, LES EAUX DE CHANEL fragrances create a feeling of freshness so vivid that it takes you on a journey.

"Dior Addict Eau de Parfum unleashes fresh and captivating top notes that blend Mandarin Leaf with Tunisian Orange Blossom. Intense and vibrant, it reveals a powerful heart of Jasmine Sambac Absolute that blossoms with soft femininity and sensuality. The base unfurls in the deep and exquisite warmth of Bourbon Vanilla. A soft and seductive trail tinged with light."
