name: Allure Homme Edition Blanche
gender: men. Allure Homme Edition Blanche was launched in 2008. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge. The fragrance features Sicilian Lemon, Madagascar Vanilla, Calabrian bergamot, Pink Pepper, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean, Tahitian Vetiver, Musk, Cedar and Amber

name: Dior Homme Parfum
desc:
The new version will introduce the very essence of Dior Homme, in an unusual concentration which leaves an urban and intense impression. The nobility of its ingredients is expressed by the uniqueness of the skin.

DIOR HOMME PARFUM contains three key notes of the composition printed on its bottle: Iris from Tuscany, sandalwood from Sri Lanka and dark and masculine leather accord. The fragrance is available in a distinctive glass bottle of 75 ml at a price of 102.50 Euros. The outer packaging is black with discreet detailing in gold color.

name: Dior Addict Eau de Parfum (2014)
desc:
Dior Addict Eau de Parfum is again reformulated in 2014 (the original is from 2002, and the new version is from 2012). The scent comes in a dark blue bottle of the signature design, this time decorated with silver details.

The fragrance opens with mandarin leaf and orange blossom. The heart includes Sambac jasmine absolute, laid on the base of Bourbon vanilla.

It is available as 30, 50 and 100 ml Eau de Parfum.

name: Allure Sensuelle Eau de Toilette
desc: Allure Sensuelle Eau de Toilette is described as a modern, magnetic scent which represents a lighter and more refined way to wear this perfume. Floral - oriental, bright and spicy, it reveals fascinating layers of female attractiveness. Available as 50 and 100 ml Eau de Toilette.

name: Allure Sensuelle Parfum
desc: Allure Sensuelle perfume is a perfume extract, which is made of absolute jasmine and May rose, Borubon vanilla and oriental notes, available in bottles of 7.5 ml.
gender: women. Allure Sensuelle Parfum was launched in 2006. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge. The fragrance features Oriental notes, May Rose, Bourbon Vanilla and Jasmine

name: Chanel No 5 Parfum
desc:
The legendary Chanel No 5, which was created by Ernest Beaux in 1921 for Coco Chanel, was originally launched in three concentrations: Parfum, Eau de Toilette and Eau de Cologne. Chanel No. 5 perfume edition in perfume extract concentration, available in bottles of 7.5 ml.

Chanel N°5 is the first perfume in the floral-aldehyde group and the first by the quantity of aldehydes in its composition (another legend says that the Ernest Beaux's assistant overdosed the aldehydes in the composition by mistake). The top notes are composed of aldehydes, bergamot, lemon, neroli and ylang-ylang, the heart of jasmine, rose, lily of the valley and iris, while the base is created of vetiver, sandalwood, vanilla, amber and patchouli.

name: Allure Homme Edition Blanche Eau de Parfum
Hypnotic Poison Diable Rouge
desc:
Dior launches Hypnotic Poison in 1998. The first limited edition of this fragrance was launched in the winter of the same year- Hypnotic Poison Diable Rouge - intensive fragrance in concentration of Eau de Parfum that comes in a luxurious red garnet bottle decorated with bohemian necklace of beads and crystals. The composition is enhanced with notes that include amber, musk and woods.

The fragrance is available as 50 ml Eau de Parfum, limited edition.

name: Dune Esprit de Parfum
desc: Dune Esprit de Parfum was launched in 1994 as an enhanced version of the original fragrance Dune from 1991. This is the third version in a row, after the original Eau de Toilette and perfume extract concentration. It contains notes of rose, peony, lily, wallflower, gorse, moss, amber, vanilla, sandalwood and benzoin. It was originally launched in a gold bottle. It is available in bottles of 30 and 50 ml.

name: Les Exclusifs de Chanel Misia
desc:
Chanel launches a new edition within the collection Les Exclusifs de Chanel in March 2015. It is a feminine scent called Misia, named after Misia Sert, a good friend of Coco Chanel and pianist of artistic origin who owned a saloon in Paris and was a muse for many artists of that period. The fragrance is for the free, modern and confident woman.

The composition was created by Olivier Polge, and it represents his first venture for the house of Chanel. Olivier Polge is the son of Jacques Polge, who has been the official in-house perfumer since 1978. Powdery notes of violet, iris, orris root, Turkish rose and rose from Grasse evoke the era of the 1920s. The warm and seductive base is made of notes of benzoin from Laos and tonka bean. The fragrance is powdery, floral and reminiscent of the scent of expensive makeup.

Available as 75 and 200 ml Eau de Toilette.

name: Miss Dior Parfum pour Cheveux
desc:
Miss Dior Parfum pour Cheveux or Hair Mist is launched in bottles of 30 ml in March 2015. It contains notes of bergamot, Egyptian jasmine grandiflorum, rose, musk and Indonesian patchouli.

It is created by the perfumer Francois Demachy: “Perfuming the hair is an age-old gesture that is still just as elegant today, with just as stirring an effect. Miss Dior Hair Mist is discreet and appealing at the same time. An ‘art of seduction’ that is subtly diffused soon as the hair moves”.

name: Miss Dior Le Parfum Edition d’Exception
desc:
The house Dior pays homage to its legendary perfume Miss Dior (original from 1947 and the new version of 2012) with limited edition called Miss Dior Le Parfum Edition d'Exception. The fragrance was launched in 2013, available in only 12 copies.

The fragrance contains precious composition of Miss Dior Le Parfum, developed by perfumer Francois Demachy in 2012. The composition contains Damascus rose absolute and essence of Indonesian patchouli.

New luxury bottle of cut glass comes with a black satin ribbon, which was decorated by Dior couture ateliers. The ribbon is embroidered with silver particles, pink beads and silk flowers.

name: Miss Dior Edition d’Exception
desc:
The house Dior pays homage to its legendary perfume Miss Dior (original from 1947 and the new version from 2012) with a limited edition called Miss Dior Edition d'Exception. In 2013, Dior released Miss Dior Le Parfum d'Exception Edition available in only 12 copies. In the spring of 2015, we have Miss Dior Edition d'Exception edition in 25 bottles.

The fragrance contains the same composition as Miss Dior Eau de Parfum, developed by perfumer Francois Demachy in 2012. It features citrus accords of mandarin, Egyptian jasmine, rose, Indonesian patchouli and musk.

The new Haute Couture bottle is decorated with hand-made lace bow. In order to prepare 25 bows, it took 5.5 meters of lace. The lace is decorated with floral motifs, made with a special technique similar to the technique of watercolor.

Available as 200 ml Eau de Parfum. One bottle costs 1800 Euros.

name: Narcotico
desc: "This scent tells a time of my life, the life of a visionary. This a journey, while listening to the sound of smell and the smell of words".

name: Dior Addict Limited Edition Collect It
gender: women. The fragrance features African Orange Flower, Petitgrain and Rose

name: XJ 1861 Naxos
desc:
At perfume exhibition in Milan - Esxence 2015, Xerjoff presented for the first time his collection of three perfumes dedicated to 150th anniversary of unification of Italy and is inspired by wealth, beauty and heritage that this country possesses. The collection of XJ 1861 encompasses three fragrances XJ 1861 Renaissance, XJ 1861 Zefiro and XJ 1861 Naxos each of which provides a part of beautiful Italy: Renaissance celebrates this period in Italy, Naxos Sicily, while Zefiro celebrates eternal Rome!

XJ 1861 Naxos celebrates Sicily and its beauty, and accentuates its Mediterranean character with the composition. Citruses in top notes pose contrast to precious spices suggesting wealth of a unified country, its conquests and dominance. Composition of Naxos opens with classic, airy and fruity citrus notes of bergamot and lemon surrounded with gentle and calming lavender shades. The heart blends sambac jasmine with cinnamon, cashmeran and honey, whose romantic trail is enriched with masculine accords of tobacco and tonka from the base. Vanilla creates a soft and sensual veil by touching flowers, fruit and tobacco leaves.

name: Chance Eau Vive
desc:
Chanel launches the new fragrance CHANCE EAU VIVE which belongs to the Chanel Chance collection and arrives on the market on June 12th 2015. The collection was started with fragrance Chanel Chance in 2003, followed by versions Chanel Chance Eau Fraiche in 2007 and Chanel Chance Eau Tendre in 2010. The collection is refreshed with new flacon form at the beginning of this year, so the fragrances can also be purchased as 35 ml now.

CHANEL CHANCE EAU VIVE is signed by perfumer Olivier Polge who blends sparkling notes of grapefruit with juicy, explosive red orange, providing citrus splash to elegant jasmine and white musk. Base notes of the composition mix vetiver, cedar and iris, leaving a fresh, gentle, elegant and subtle trail.

Fragrance repeats the same flacon form as previous editions of the collection and will be available as 50 and 100 ml Eau de Toilette.

name: Eau Sauvage Cologne
desc:
The classic fresh masculine fragrance by Dior—Eau Sauvage from 1966, was re-interpreted in a new format, as Eau Sauvage Cologne, in the spring of 2015. As for Eau Sauvage Parfum edition from 2012, vintage photographs and recordings of French actor Alain Delon were used for the advertising campaign of Eau Sauvage Cologne.

The fresh citrusy-spicy and woody composition begins with accords of Calabrian bergamot, mandarin and bitter grapefruit. The heart notes include galbanum, petitgrain, hedione and pink pepper, while the base consists of woody tones of vetiver.

Photos of advertising campaign originate from the movie "The Last Adventure" by Robert Enrico, filmed in 1967. The fragrance is available in bottles of 50 and 100 ml.

name: Chanel No 5 Eau Premiere (2015)
desc:
"Modern, airy interpretation of No5... Silky-smooth harmony of notes that reveals delicate aspects of the fragrance of nowadays and future"—Chanel

As a limited edition presented on website Chanel.com, CHANEL NO 5 EAU PREMIERE arrives in a new flacon with an outer carton for which you can select the graphic design in 10 different versions. The new edition was introduced just before Summer 2015.

It features campaign "The One That I Want" which was launched for Chanel No5 edition together with an advertising movie with Baz Luhrmann and beautiful Gisele Bündchen. In the new Chanel movie Lo-Fang (also known as Matthew Hemerlein) participates with his voice, singing the acoustic version of the popular song "The One That I Want" from Grease.

Chanel No5 Eau Premiere is a younger and more modern version of timeless Chanel No5. Its scent is airier and the color of its liquid is lighter. The composition encompasses luminous, sunny and fluffy notes which refresh the floral heart resting on a fine, soft, creamy base. No5 Eau Premiere takes the floral notes of the No5 edition (jasmine from Grasse fields, owned by Chanel, rose absolute, ylang-ylang from Comoro islands, neroli) refreshed with aldehydes and accompanied with sandalwood, vanilla and vetiver. The perfumer is Jacques Polge. The first No5 Eau Premiere edition was presented in a 125 ml flacon, back in 2007.

name: Chance Parfum
gender: women. Chance Parfum was launched in 2003. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge. The fragrance features Jasmine, Iris, White Musk and Vanilla Absolute

name: Coco Eau de Toilette
gender: women. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge. Top notes are Bulgarian Rose, Coriander, Peach, Mandarin Orange and Jasmine; middle notes are Cloves, Rose, Mimosa, Orange Blossom and Clover; base notes are Sandalwood, Amber, Opoponax, Civet, Vanilla, Labdanum and Tonka Bean

name: Coco Parfum
gender: women. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge. Top notes are Bulgarian Rose, Peach, Coriander, Jasmine and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Rose, Cloves, Mimosa, Orange Blossom and Clover; base notes are Amber, Opoponax, Civet, Labdanum, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean and Vanilla

name: African Leather
desc:
Inspired by the African continent, this fragrance unveils warm spicy notes of cardamom and saffron over a floral touch of geranium, which mingle with a leather accord to give life to an exceptional wild leather.

South Africa is where geranium first grew in the wild, and its presence in African Leather is a nod to its origins. Sustainably cultivated in Egypt, this particular geranium has a floral, aromatic and green character that encounters hand-picked Guatemalan cardamom, a spice with green, fruity, almost-candied accents that was used as incense in Ancient Egyptian times.

name: J’adore Touche de Parfum
gender: women. J’adore Touche de Parfum was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy. The fragrance features Sandalwood, Jasmine Sambac, Musk, Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Damask Rose, Iris and Hibiscus

name: J'adore Le Jasmin
gender: women. J'adore Le Jasmin was launched in 2007. The fragrance features Jasmine, Magnolia, Violet, Woody Notes, Mandarin Orange, Plum, Rose, Orchid, Cedar and Ivy

name: Sauvage
desc:
Dior launches its new fragrance Sauvage, with the name originating from the fragrance Eau Sauvage from 1966, although the two don’t belong to the same collection. Sauvage is inspired by wild, open spaces; blue sky that covers rocky landscapes, hot under the desert sun.

Dior in-house perfumer, François Demachy, signed this creation. The fragrance is announced as radically fresh, raw and noble at the same time. The composition is reportedly prevalent with carefully selected natural ingredients. Fresh top notes of Calabria bergamot encounter ambroxan, obtained from precious ambergris, and its woody trail.

Dior Sauvage comes out in September 2015, advertised by actor Johnny Depp. It is available as 60 and 100 ml Eau de Toilette.

name: Dior Addict 2 Summer Breeze
gender: women. Dior Addict 2 Summer Breeze was launched in 2006. The fragrance features Magnolia, White Flowers, Precious Woods, Petitgrain and Grapefruit

name: Allure Parfum
gender: women. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge. The fragrance features Mandarin Orange, Vanilla and Rose de Mai

name: Carlisle
desc: Carlisle by Parfum XXI is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Carlisle was launched in 2015. Top notes are bergamot and mandarin orange; middle notes are violet and jasmine; base notes are guaiac wood, patchouli and cardamom. This edition of Parfums De Marly Harrod’s London exclusive.

name: Dior Addict 2 Summer Litchi
desc:
This fresh, floral fragrance by the house of Christian Dior arrives in May 2008 at the market. The new limited version of the perfume Addict 2 is created in honour of Chinese cherry known as litchi, and it celebrates summer in a bottle with charming, pink motifs.

The perfume Dior Addict 2 Summer Litchi includes sparkling notes of grapefruit, with accords of the heart which seduces with notes of litchi and Turkish rose. The base notes introduce white musk.

The bottle has the same shape as its pink antecedents and it represents litchi tree in pink nuances. The perfume is available as 50 ml EDT limited edition.

name: Bois Noir
gender: men. Bois Noir was launched in 1987. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge. The fragrance features Sandalwood, Rose, Lavender, Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Brazilian Rosewood, Mandarin Orange, Coriander and Bourbon Vanilla

name: Poison Esprit de Parfum
gender: women. Poison Esprit de Parfum was launched during the 1990's. The nose behind this fragrance is Edouard Flechier. Top notes are Plum, Forest Fruits, Anise, Coriander, Palisander Rosewood and Pepper; middle notes are Tuberose, Honey, Incense, Cloves, Cinnamon, Opoponax, Rose, Jasmine and Orange Blossom; base notes are Amber, Vanilla, Musk, Sandalwood, Heliotrope, Vetiver and Cedar

name: Poison Girl
desc:
In January 2016, Dior introduces a new addition to the Poison collection by the name of Poison Girl, intended for younger lovers of the iconic brand, which comes in a pink bottle in the classic shape of Poison. The new fragrance is announced as a bitter - sweet floral, scandalously delicious, made for rebellious young women, pop - feminists who follow their dreams.

The composition consists of precious raw ingredients. Sicilian bitter orange leads to the heart of roses, which consists of May rose from Grasse and Damascus rose. Venezuelan tonka bean, sandalwood from Sri Lanka, tolu balm, almond and vanilla end with a warm, oriental sweetness. The perfumer is Francois Demachy.

The face of the perfume is French - American model and actress Camille Rowe. The fragrance is available as 30, 50 and 100 ml Eau de Parfum.

name: J'adore Lumiere Eau de Toilette
desc:
J'adore Lumière comes out in the spring of 2016 as a new edition of the popular Dior J'adore perfume from 1999.

Dior’s in-house perfumer Francois Demachy wanted to emphasize the luminous character of the J'adore Eau de Toilette version from 2011. He wanted to strengthen its contrasts, adjust its layers and restore its freshness, remaining faithful to its original floral character. The aim for this new edition is to be filled with light, joy and zest for life, as the scent of white flowers and citruses under the hot Mediterranean sun.

The cheerful top notes explode with essence of blood orange. The fragrance unfolds with intense and fresh neroli from Vallauris. The sweet character of vanilla, blended with flowers of magnolia and fresh lemon, meets with lively notes of Damascus rose. Sensual sandalwood provides a sense of comfort, allowing the aroma to unfold even brighter.

Available as a 50 and 100 ml Eau de Toilette.

name: Chocolat
gender: women and men. Top notes are Nutmeg, Tangerine, Sandalwood and Galbanum; middle notes are Cacao, Plum, Rose and Jasmine; base note is Vanilla

name: Miss Dior Cherie Blooming Bouquet 2007
desc:
Miss Dior Cherie Blooming Bouquet arrives in summer 2008. This is a blooming bouquet of emotions and notes, announced as summer interpretation of Miss Dior Cherie EDT edition of 2007, which was not well accepted at Asian market, since it was considered \"too Western\".

Dominant notes of this fragrance are mandarin in the top notes, peony flowers in the heart and sensual white musk trace in the base note. The bottle has the same shape, liquid is pink, which contributes to the feeling of romance.

It comes in 100ml (3.4fl.oz) EDT bottle.

name: Miss Dior Brume Soyeuse pour le Corps
desc:
Miss Dior Silky Body Mist (Miss Dior Brume Soyeuse pour le Corps ) is airy and sensual easy to apply formula that combines the benefits of an enhancing body care with the freshness of a mist. It delicately perfumes and beautifies the skin. Light and non-oily, it preserves the skin’s hydration for 6 hours, leaving it nourished, smooth, glowing and with the trail of the Miss Dior fragrance.

“The silky texture of Miss Dior Silky Body Mist creates a delicate trail, full of nuance. A moment in the beauty ritual to truly connect with oneself.”, François Demachy.

available in a 100 ml bottle.

name: La Colle Noire (2018)
desc: "In springtime, the Centifolia rose invades the gardens at La Colle Noire, Christian Dior's beloved home in Grasse. It is an extraordinary time, when the flower's fleshy, honeyed and fruity scent lingers in the air. This perfume is an ode to that magical place and to the unique rose that grows in my home." - FRANÇOIS DEMACHY, Dior Perfumer-Creator.

name: Chanel No 5 L'Eau
desc:
The latest fragrance in the legendary Chanel N°5 line is scheduled for the fall of 2016. Chanel N°5 L’Eau is the flanker that aims to capture the younger, millennial audience. The scent was developed by Olivier Polge as a light and fresh interpretation of the sophisticated original, featuring prominent note of May rose from Grasse. Olivier Polge has apparently been working on this composition since 2013.

Top notes: lemon, mandarin, orange, neroli and aldehydes. Heart: rose, ylang-ylang, jasmine. Base: cedar, white musk.

The face of the campaign is Lily-Rose Depp. Available in bottles of 50 and 100 ml.

name: Acqua e Zucchero
gender: women and men. Acqua e Zucchero was launched in 2002. The fragrance features Vanilla, Forest Fruits and Orange Blossom

name: Miss Dior Absolutely Blooming
desc:
Dior presents its new fragrance Miss Dior Absolutely Blooming from the famous Miss Dior collection in August 2016. The in-house perfumer Francois Demachy announced it as the edition that opens with bright fruity notes, intended for cheerful women who love life.

Miss Dior Absolutely Blooming is a new olfactory variation of Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet, designed as a sexier, more passionate and more modern scent. The hot pink color of the liquid matches the delicious floral character. The composition is comprised of three layers: red berries, Centifolia May rose from Grasse and peony, as well as white musk.

It is available in 30, 50 and 100 ml sizes.

name: Midnight Poison Elixir
desc:
In cooperation with perfumer Francois Demachy, Dior presents three new versions of their already-existing perfumes. These are the three magical perfumes known as Midnight Poison, Hypnotic Poison, and Pure Poison, which are now presented in the form of an elixir and are available in their well-known bottle shapes and colours in amounts of 30 and 50 ml, with atomizers.

The Midnight Poison Elixir perfume will seduce you with new aromas of caramel and vanilla. It was presented in 2008.
gender: women. Midnight Poison Elixir was launched in 2008. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy. The fragrance features Patchouli, Caramel, Rose, Vanilla and Amber

name: Hypnotic Poison Elixir
gender: women. Hypnotic Poison Elixir was launched in 2008. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy. The fragrance features Vanilla, Licorice, Star Anise and Jasmine

name: Chanel No 5 Eau de Parfum
desc:
The Chanel No 5 Eau de Parfum was created by Jacques Polges in 1986 as another interpretation of the iconic original fragrance introduced by Coco Chanel and created by Ernest Beaux in 1921.

Top notes include neroli, ylang-ylang, peach, bergamot and aldehydes. Middle notes include fresh jasmine, lily of the valley, iris and may rose. Base notes capture deep blend of Mysore sandalwood, vetiver, moss, patchouli and Bourbon vanilla.

Carole Bouquet became the face of the fragrance.

name: Dior Homme Sport
desc:
In the autumn of 2008, Dior launches Dior Homme Sport, presented as a fresh and explosive fragrance devoted to younger population. Dior Homme Sport fragrance enhances the free spirit of a young man and is announced as an explosive citrus fragrance with a woody base and ginger accord, which follows the tradition of Dior Homme aromas. Presented as a fresh scent of luxury, it comes in the same bottle as its predecessor. The face of the campaign is actor Jude Law. It is available as 50 and 100ml EDT.

The creator of this edition is Francois Demachy, who found his inspiration in the special flavors of red pepper from the U.S.A. The original idea was to create a fragrance that evokes the feeling and sensation that we have while eating candy. Very spicy, burning effects with fresh burst that simply make you breathe deeply.

The top notes are aromas of grapefruit, bergamot, elemi resin and Sicilian lemon. The heart includes Atlas cedar and vetiver with ginger, while base notes include sandalwood accords with pronounced aromas of rosemary and lavender.

name: The Tragedy of Lord George
gender: men. The Tragedy of Lord George was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Alberto Morillas. The fragrance features Woodsy Notes, Brandy, Amber and Tonka Bean

name: Jules (2016)
desc:
In 2016, Dior brings back its iconic fragrance Jules to the European market (namely Russia), the second masculine perfume of this house. Jules, whose name comes from the French slang for seducer / lover, was developed by perfumer Jean Martel in 1980, more than 10 years after the first masculine fragrance Eau Sauvage. The advertising campaign involved the illustrations from artist Rene Gruau, and one of the slogans read as "Strong and gentle".

The composition of the 2016 release offers green top notes of Iranian galbanum mixed with herbs. Indian black pepper, the best example of its kind, forms the intensive heart of the perfume, together with floral accents of cyclamen and hedione. Refined and noble American cedar oil and leather round the composition in the base.

The fragrance is available as a 100 ml Eau de Toilette at a price of around 70 Euros.

name: Sea Salt & Fig
gender: women and men. Sea Salt & Fig was launched in 2016. The fragrance features Fig and Sea Salt

name: Fahrenheit Summer 2007
gender: men. Fahrenheit Summer 2007 was launched in 2007. The fragrance features Violet, Freesia, Citruses, Cedar, Patchouli, Sandalwood and Amber

name: Jersey Eau de Parfum
desc:
Jersey Eau de Parfum, "an olfactory garment," is an aromatic, floral, and powdery scent of a soft and refined high quality lavender. Shrouded in a cloud of white musk and spiced by rich vanilla, the lavender loses its boyish character and reveals its sophisticated floral side.

At the end of September 2016, Chanel launched the Eau de Parfum versions of its prestigious Les Exclusifs de Chanel perfume line. The new concentration will gradually completely replace the existing Eau de Toilette editions. The fragrances are available as 75 ml and 200 ml Eau de Parfum.
gender: women. Jersey Eau de Parfum was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge. The fragrance features Lavender, White Musk, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Wildflowers, Grass, Jasmine and Rose
